sanskrit_iast: mantradṛgbhyo namaskṛtvā samāmnāyānupūrvaśaḥ | sūktargardharcapādānām ṛgbhyo vakṣyāmi daivatam ||
meaning: मन्त्रदृग्भ्यो नमस्कृत्वा समाम्नायानुपूर्वशः | सूक्तर्गर्धर्चपादानाम् ऋग्भ्यो वक्ष्यामि दैवतम् ||
text: With obeisance to the seers of formulas, I will, in the sequence of the traditional text, state for (all) stanzas the divinity of the hymn, the stanza, the hemistich, and the verse.

sanskrit_iast: veditavyaṃ daivataṃ hi mantre mantre prayatnataḥ | daivatajño hi mantrāṇāṃ tadarthamavagacchati ||
meaning: वेदितव्यं दैवतं हि मन्त्रे मन्त्रे प्रयत्नतः | दैवतज्ञो हि मन्त्राणां तदर्थमवगच्छति ||
text: In every formula one should know the divinity with exactness; for he who knows the divinities of the formulas, understands their object.

sanskrit_iast: taddhitāṃstadabhiprāyān ṛṣīṇāṃ mantradṛṣṭiṣu | vijñāpayati vijñānaṃ karmāṇi vividhāni ca ||
meaning: तद्धितांस्तदभिप्रायान् ऋषीणां मन्त्रदृष्टिषु | विज्ञापयति विज्ञानं कर्माणि विविधानि च ||
text: He is capable of giving an (authoritative) opinion (vijnapayati) as to their (tad = mantranam) intentions a which were contained (hitan) in them (tad) at the time when the formulas were revealed to the seers (rsinam mantradrstisu), (and) as to the correct understanding (of them) and the various ceremonies (connected with them).

sanskrit_iast: na hi kaścidavijñāya yāthātathyena daivatam | laukyānāṃ vaidikānāṃ vā karmaṇāṃ phalamaśnute ||
meaning: न हि कश्चिदविज्ञाय याथातथ्येन दैवतम् | लौक्यानां वैदिकानां वा कर्मणां फलमश्नुते ||
text: For no one without really having correct knowledge of the divinity (addressed in the formula), attains to the fruit of customary or Vedic ceremonies.

sanskrit_iast: prathamo bhajate tvāsāṃ vargo'gnimiha daivatam | dvitīyo vāyumindraṃ vā tṛtīyaḥ sūryameva ca ||
meaning: प्रथमो भजते त्वासां वर्गोऽग्निमिह दैवतम् | द्वितीयो वायुमिन्द्रं वा तृतीयः सूर्यमेव च ||
text: The first group of these (deities) belongs here to the divinity Agni, the second to Vayu or Indra, and the third to Surya.

sanskrit_iast: arthamicchannṛṣirdeṃvaṃ yaṃ yamāhāyamastviti | prādhānyena stuvanbhaktyā mantrastaddeva eva saḥ ||
meaning: अर्थमिच्छन्नृषिर्देंवं यं यमाहायमस्त्विति | प्राधान्येन स्तुवन्भक्त्या मन्त्रस्तद्देव एव सः ||
text: Whatever god a seer desiring an object mentions, let that one, it is said, be (the god of the formula). A formula predominantly praising (a god) with devotion, is addressed to that same god.

sanskrit_iast: stutistu nāmnā rūpeṇa karmaṇā bāndhavena ca | svargāyurdhanaputrādyair arthairāśīstu kathyate ||
meaning: स्तुतिस्तु नाम्ना रूपेण कर्मणा बान्धवेन च | स्वर्गायुर्धनपुत्राद्यैर् अर्थैराशीस्तु कथ्यते ||
text: Praise is expressed by means of name, form, action, and relationship, but prayer by means of objects such as heaven, long life, wealth, and sons.

sanskrit_iast: stutyāśiṣau tu' yāsvṛkṣu dṛśyete'lpāstu tā iha | tābhyāścālpatarāstāḥ syuḥ svargo yābhistu yācyate ||
meaning: स्तुत्याशिषौ तु' यास्वृक्षु दृश्येतेऽल्पास्तु ता इह | ताभ्याश्चाल्पतरास्ताः स्युः स्वर्गो याभिस्तु याच्यते ||
text: The stanzas in which both praise and prayer appear, are here (in the Rg-veda) but few; still fewer than these are those in which heaven is prayed for.

sanskrit_iast: stuvantaṃ veda sarvo'yam arthayatyeṣa māmiti | stautītyarthaṃ bruvantaṃ ca sārthaṃ māmeṣa paśyati ||
meaning: स्तुवन्तं वेद सर्वोऽयम् अर्थयत्येष मामिति | स्तौतीत्यर्थं ब्रुवन्तं च सार्थं मामेष पश्यति ||
text: Every one of us (sarvo 'yam) recognizes one who praises, (thinking) this man wants something from me,' and (he also recognizes) one who states an object, (thinking) 'he praises, (that is) he regards me as one having (those) objects (to bestow).'

sanskrit_iast: stuvadbhirvā bruvadbhirvā ṛṣibhistattvadarśibhiḥ | bhavatyubhayamevoktam ubhayaṃ hyarthataḥ samam ||
meaning: स्तुवद्भिर्वा ब्रुवद्भिर्वा ऋषिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः | भवत्युभयमेवोक्तम् उभयं ह्यर्थतः समम् ||
text: But whether the seers who discern the truth either praise or state (an object), they express both; for both are in reality the same.

sanskrit_iast: pratyakṣaṃ devatānāma yasminmantre'bhidhīyate | tāmeva devatāṃ vidyān mantre lakṣaṇasaṃpadā ||
meaning: प्रत्यक्षं देवतानाम यस्मिन्मन्त्रेऽभिधीयते | तामेव देवतां विद्यान् मन्त्रे लक्षणसंपदा ||
text: When the name of a deity is mentioned in the second person a in a formula, one should know that to be the deity in the formula, because (that) indication is there (sampada).

sanskrit_iast: tasmāttu devatāṃ nāmnā mantre mantre prayogavit | bahutvamabhidhānāṃ ca prayatnenopalakṣayet ||
meaning: तस्मात्तु देवतां नाम्ना मन्त्रे मन्त्रे प्रयोगवित् | बहुत्वमभिधानां च प्रयत्नेनोपलक्षयेत् ||
text: Therefore one familiar with (the) application (of formulas) should in every formula carefully observe the deity, with regard to name, and the multiplicity of the designations (of deities).

sanskrit_iast: sampūrṇamṛṣivākyaṃ tu sūktamityabhidhīyate | dṛśyante devatā yasminn ekasmin bahuṣu dvayoḥ ||
meaning: सम्पूर्णमृषिवाक्यं तु सूक्तमित्यभिधीयते | दृश्यन्ते देवता यस्मिन्न् एकस्मिन् बहुषु द्वयोः ||
text: The complete utterance of a seer is designated a hymn (sukta), in which the deities appear in one, in many, (or) in two (formulas).

sanskrit_iast: devatārṣārthachandasto vaividhyaṃ ca prajāyate | ṛṣisūktaṃ tu yāvanti sūktānyekasya vai stutiḥ ||
meaning: देवतार्षार्थछन्दस्तो वैविध्यं च प्रजायते | ऋषिसूक्तं तु यावन्ति सूक्तान्येकस्य वै स्तुतिः ||
text: A variety arises with regard to the deity, the authorship, the subject, and the metre. All hymns which are revealed as the praise of one single (seer, constitute) a seer's hymn (rsisukta); for that is the (aggregate) hymn of that seer. In so far as a subject is completed (in several stanzas), they call it a subject-hymn (artha-sukta).

sanskrit_iast: śrūyante tāni sarvāṇi ṛṣeḥ sūktaṃ hi tasya tat | yāvadarthasamāptiḥ syād arthasūktaṃ vadanti tat ||
meaning: श्रूयन्ते तानि सर्वाणि ऋषेः सूक्तं हि तस्य तत् | यावदर्थसमाप्तिः स्याद् अर्थसूक्तं वदन्ति तत् ||

sanskrit_iast: samānachandaso yāḥ syus tacchandaḥ sūktamucyate | vaividhyamevaṃ sūktānām iha vidyādyathātatham ||
meaning: समानछन्दसो याः स्युस् तच्छन्दः सूक्तमुच्यते | वैविध्यमेवं सूक्तानाम् इह विद्याद्यथातथम् ||
text: (The stanzas) which have a common metre are called a metre-hymn (chandah-sukta). Thus one should here recognize the variety of hymns such as it really is. yah

sanskrit_iast: devatānāmadheyāni mantreṣu trividhāni tu | sūktabhāñjyathavarabhāñji tathā naipātikāni tu ||
meaning: देवतानामधेयानि मन्त्रेषु त्रिविधानि तु | सूक्तभाञ्ज्यथवरभाञ्जि तथा नैपातिकानि तु ||
text: The denominations of the deities in the formulas are of three kinds such as belong to (whole) hymn, or such as belong to a stanza (only), as well as such as are incidental.

sanskrit_iast: sūktabhāñji bhajante vai sūktānyṛgbhāñji vai ṛcaḥ | mantrai'nyadaivate'nyāni nigadyante'tra kānicit ||
meaning: सूक्तभाञ्जि भजन्ते वै सूक्तान्यृग्भाञ्जि वै ऋचः | मन्त्रैऽन्यदैवतेऽन्यानि निगद्यन्तेऽत्र कानिचित् ||
text: (Names) belonging to hymns belong to (whole) hymns, those belonging to stanzas belong to (single) stanzas (only). In a formula addressed to one divinity certain other (names) are here mentioned, bhajante vai

sanskrit_iast: sālokyātsāhacaryādvā tāni naipātikāni tu | tasmādbahuprakāre'pi sūkte syātsūktabhāginī ||
meaning: सालोक्यात्साहचर्याद्वा तानि नैपातिकानि तु | तस्माद्बहुप्रकारेऽपि सूक्ते स्यात्सूक्तभागिनी ||

sanskrit_iast: devatā tadyathā sūktam aviśeṣyaṃ pratīyate | bhinne sūkte vadedeva devatāmiha liṅgataḥ ||
meaning: देवता तद्यथा सूक्तम् अविशेष्यं प्रतीयते | भिन्ने सूक्ते वदेदेव देवतामिह लिङ्गतः ||

sanskrit_iast: tatra tatra yathāvacca mantrānkarmasu yojayet | devatāyāḥ parijñānāt taddhi karma samṛdhyate ||
meaning: तत्र तत्र यथावच्च मन्त्रान्कर्मसु योजयेत् | देवतायाः परिज्ञानात् तद्धि कर्म समृध्यते ||
text: In each case one should duly connect the formulas with the rites by ascertaining the deity; for that is the rite which is completely successful.

sanskrit_iast: ādyantayostu sūktānāṃ prasaṅgaparikīrtanāt | stotṛbhirdevatā nāmnā upekṣeteha mantravit ||
meaning: आद्यन्तयोस्तु सूक्तानां प्रसङ्गपरिकीर्तनात् | स्तोतृभिर्देवता नाम्ना उपेक्षेतेह मन्त्रवित् ||

sanskrit_iast: tatkhalvāhuḥ katibhyastu karmabhyo nāma jāyate | sattvānāṃ vaidikānāṃ vā yadvānyadiha kiṃcana ||
meaning: तत्खल्वाहुः कतिभ्यस्तु कर्मभ्यो नाम जायते | सत्त्वानां वैदिकानां वा यद्वान्यदिह किंचन ||
text: As to that, indeed, they say: 'from how many actions does a name arise, whether of Vedic beings or any other (name occurring) here?'

sanskrit_iast: navabhya iti nairuktāḥ purāṇāḥ kavayaśca ye | madhukaḥ śvetaketuśca gālavaścaiva manvate ||
meaning: नवभ्य इति नैरुक्ताः पुराणाः कवयश्च ये | मधुकः श्वेतकेतुश्च गालवश्चैव मन्वते ||
text: 'From nine,' say the etymologists, and the ancient sages Madhuka, Svetaketu, and Galava think so too: puranah all MSS. except

sanskrit_iast: nivāsātkarmaṇo rūpān maṅgalādvāca āśiṣaḥ | yadṛcchayopavasanāt tathāmuṣyāyaṇācca yat ||
meaning: निवासात्कर्मणो रूपान् मङ्गलाद्वाच आशिषः | यदृच्छयोपवसनात् तथामुष्यायणाच्च यत् ||
text: (viz.) that which (comes) from abode, action, form, luck, speech, prayer, from accident, as well as addiction a and extraction

sanskrit_iast: caturbhya iti tatrāhur yāskagārgyarathītarāḥ | āśiṣo'thārthavairūpyād vācaḥ karmaṇa eva ca ||
meaning: चतुर्भ्य इति तत्राहुर् यास्कगार्ग्यरथीतराः | आशिषोऽथार्थवैरूप्याद् वाचः कर्मण एव च ||
text: With regard to that (question), Yaska, Gargya, and Rathitara say, 'from four: from prayer, from the diversity of objects, from speech, and from action.'

sanskrit_iast: sarvāṇyetāni nāmāni karmatastvāha śaunakaḥ | āśī rūpaṃ ca vācyaṃ ca sarvaṃ bhavati karmataḥ ||
meaning: सर्वाण्येतानि नामानि कर्मतस्त्वाह शौनकः | आशी रूपं च वाच्यं च सर्वं भवति कर्मतः ||
text: Saunaka, however, says that all these names (come) from action: prayer and form and utterance, all arise from action.

sanskrit_iast: yadṛcchayopavasanāt tathāmuṣyāyaṇācca yat | tathā tadapi karmaiva tacchṛṇudhvaṃ ca hetavaḥ ||
meaning: यदृच्छयोपवसनात् तथामुष्यायणाच्च यत् | तथा तदपि कर्मैव तच्छृणुध्वं च हेतवः ||
text: Similarly, even that (name) which (comes) from acci- denta, as well as from addiction and extraction, is simply action: and so hear (what) the reasons (are).

sanskrit_iast: prajāḥ karmasamutthā hi karmataḥ sattvasaṃgatiḥ | kvacitsaṃjāyate sacca nivāsāttatprajāyate ||
meaning: प्रजाः कर्मसमुत्था हि कर्मतः सत्त्वसंगतिः | क्वचित्संजायते सच्च निवासात्तत्प्रजायते ||
text: Creatures arise from action; from action (comes) the intercourse of beings. And a being comes into existence somewhere: it is produced from (its) abode.

sanskrit_iast: yādṛcchikaṃ tu nāmābhidhīyate yatra kutracit | aupamyādapi tadvidyād bhāvasyaiveha kasyacit ||
meaning: यादृच्छिकं तु नामाभिधीयते यत्र कुत्रचित् | औपम्यादपि तद्विद्याद् भावस्यैवेह कस्यचित् ||
text: An accidental name is given somewhere or other one should know that that also is here (derived) from a comparison with some (form of) becoming. tu

sanskrit_iast: nākarmako'sti bhāvo hi na nāmāsti nirarthakam | nānyatra bhāvānnāmāni tasmātsarvāṇi karmataḥ ||
meaning: नाकर्मकोऽस्ति भावो हि न नामास्ति निरर्थकम् | नान्यत्र भावान्नामानि तस्मात्सर्वाणि कर्मतः ||
text: For there is no (form of) becoming unconnected with action, nor is any name meaningless. Names have no other source than becoming; therefore they are all derived from action. na

sanskrit_iast: maṅgalātkriyate yacca nāmopavasanācca yat | bhavatyeva tu sā hyāśīḥ svastyādermaṅgalādiha ||
meaning: मङ्गलात्क्रियते यच्च नामोपवसनाच्च यत् | भवत्येव तु सा ह्याशीः स्वस्त्यादेर्मङ्गलादिह ||
text: A name which is formed from luck and from addiction 8 simply becomes a prayer: from (words expressing) luck, such as svasti (welfare),

sanskrit_iast: api kutsitanāmāyam iha jīvetkathaṃ ciram | iti kriyante nāmāni bhūtānāṃ viditānyapi ||
meaning: अपि कुत्सितनामायम् इह जीवेत्कथं चिरम् | इति क्रियन्ते नामानि भूतानां विदितान्यपि ||

sanskrit_iast: mantrā nānāprakārāḥ syur dṛṣṭā ye mantradarśibhiḥ | stutyā caiva vibhūtyā ca prabhāvāddevatātmanaḥ ||
meaning: मन्त्रा नानाप्रकाराः स्युर् दृष्टा ये मन्त्रदर्शिभिः | स्तुत्या चैव विभूत्या च प्रभावाद्देवतात्मनः ||
text: The formulas which have been seen by the seers of such, may be of various sorts both with respect to the (kind of) praise and to the (degree of) majesty (arising) from the prominence of a deity's nature. ye

sanskrit_iast: stutiḥ praśaṃsā nindā ca saṃśayaḥ paridevanā | spṛhāśīḥ katthanā yāñcā praśnaḥ praiṣaḥ pravahlikā ||
meaning: स्तुतिः प्रशंसा निन्दा च संशयः परिदेवना | स्पृहाशीः कत्थना याञ्चा प्रश्नः प्रैषः प्रवह्लिका ||
text: Praise (47), laudation (48), blame (49), doubt (51), plaint (50), desire (53), prayer (50), boasting (51), request (49), question (50), summons (57), enigma (57), in 57.

sanskrit_iast: niyogaścānuyogaśca ślāghā vilapitaṃ ca yat | ācikhyāsātha saṃlāpaḥ pavitrākhyānameva ca ||
meaning: नियोगश्चानुयोगश्च श्लाघा विलपितं च यत् | आचिख्यासाथ संलापः पवित्राख्यानमेव च ||

sanskrit_iast: āhanasyā namaskāraḥ pratirādhastathaiva ca | saṃkalpaśca pralāpaśca prativākyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
meaning: आहनस्या नमस्कारः प्रतिराधस्तथैव च | संकल्पश्च प्रलापश्च प्रतिवाक्यं तथैव च ||
text: Lascivious verses ( 55 ), obeisance (54), obstacle (55), resolve (55), prattle ( 55 ), reply (50)

sanskrit_iast: pratiṣedhopadeśau ca pramādāpahnavau ca ha | upapraiṣaśca yaḥ proktaḥ saṃjvaro yaśca vismayaḥ ||
meaning: प्रतिषेधोपदेशौ च प्रमादापह्नवौ च ह | उपप्रैषश्च यः प्रोक्तः संज्वरो यश्च विस्मयः ||

sanskrit_iast: ākrośo'bhiṣṭavaścaiva kṣepaḥ śāpastathaiva ca | upasargo nipātaśca nāma cākhyātamityapi ||
meaning: आक्रोशोऽभिष्टवश्चैव क्षेपः शापस्तथैव च | उपसर्गो निपातश्च नाम चाख्यातमित्यपि ||

sanskrit_iast: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca pumān strī ca napuṃsakam | evaṃprakṛtayo mantrāḥ sarvavedeṣu sarvaśaḥ ||
meaning: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च पुमान् स्त्री च नपुंसकम् | एवंप्रकृतयो मन्त्राः सर्ववेदेषु सर्वशः ||

sanskrit_iast: vākyārthadarśanārthīyā ṛco'rdharcāḥ padāni ca | brāhmaṇe cātha kalpe ca nigadyante'tra kānicit ||
meaning: वाक्यार्थदर्शनार्थीया ऋचोऽर्धर्चाः पदानि च | ब्राह्मणे चाथ कल्पे च निगद्यन्तेऽत्र कानिचित् ||
text: Stanzas, hemistichs, and verses are for the purpose of setting forth the object of (their) utterances ; moreover, in Brahmana and ritual (kalpa ) some (of these stanzas &c.) here are quoted. r.

sanskrit_iast: śabdenoccariteneha yena dravyaṃ pratīyate | tadakṣaravidhau yuktaṃ nāmetyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
meaning: शब्देनोच्चरितेनेह येन द्रव्यं प्रतीयते | तदक्षरविधौ युक्तं नामेत्याहुर्मनीषिणः ||

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭau yatra prayujyante nānārtheṣu vibhaktayaḥ | tannāma kavayaḥ prāhur bhede vacanaliṅgayoḥ ||
meaning: अष्टौ यत्र प्रयुज्यन्ते नानार्थेषु विभक्तयः | तन्नाम कवयः प्राहुर् भेदे वचनलिङ्गयोः ||
text: That in which eight inflexions are employed in various senses, sages call a noun, when there is a distinction of number and gender.

sanskrit_iast: kriyāsu bahvīṣvabhisaṃśrito yaḥ pūrvāparībhūta ihaika eva | kriyābhinirvṛttivaśena siddha ākhyātaśabdena tamarthamāhuḥ ||
meaning: क्रियासु बह्वीष्वभिसंश्रितो यः पूर्वापरीभूत इहैक एव | क्रियाभिनिर्वृत्तिवशेन सिद्ध आख्यातशब्देन तमर्थमाहुः ||
text: That notion which, connected with many actions, becoming a later from an earlier, (and yet being) but one, is effected by the development of the action, they call by the term 'verb.'

sanskrit_iast: kriyābhinirvṛttivaśopajātaḥ kṛdantaśabdābhihito yadā syāt | saṃkhyāvibhaktyavyayaliṅgayukto bhāvastadā dravyamivopalakṣyaḥ ||
meaning: क्रियाभिनिर्वृत्तिवशोपजातः कृदन्तशब्दाभिहितो यदा स्यात् | संख्याविभक्त्यव्ययलिङ्गयुक्तो भावस्तदा द्रव्यमिवोपलक्ष्यः ||
text: When there is a becoming which arises from the development of an action, and which is designated by a term with a primary suffix, and which is joined with number, inflexion (or) indeclinable form (avyaya), and gender, then it is to be regarded as a substantive (dravya).

sanskrit_iast: yathā nānāvidhaiḥ śabdair apaśyannṛṣayaḥ purā | vividhānīha vākyāni tānyanukramataḥ śṛṇu ||
meaning: यथा नानाविधैः शब्दैर् अपश्यन्नृषयः पुरा | विविधानीह वाक्यानि तान्यनुक्रमतः शृणु ||
text: Hear now, in succession, how the seers formerly with terms of different kinds saw their various utterances here.

sanskrit_iast: rūpādibhi stutiḥ proktā āśīḥ svargādibhistathā | yāni vākyānyato'nyāni tānyapi syūranekadhā ||
meaning: रूपादिभि स्तुतिः प्रोक्ता आशीः स्वर्गादिभिस्तथा | यानि वाक्यान्यतोऽन्यानि तान्यपि स्यूरनेकधा ||
text: By means of (attributing) beautiful form and so forth, praise (35) is pronounced; similarly prayer by (such terms as) heaven and so forth. The utterances which are different from these may also be of many kinds.

sanskrit_iast: mantre praśaṃsā bhojasya citra it sobhare stutiḥ | ākrośārthāstu dṛśyante mātā cetyabhimethati ||
meaning: मन्त्रे प्रशंसा भोजस्य चित्र इत् सोभरे स्तुतिः | आक्रोशार्थास्तु दृश्यन्ते माता चेत्यभिमेथति ||
text: In the formula Citra indeed' (citra it: viii. 21. 18) Sobhari's praise of the liberal giver is a laudation (35). (Formulas) expressive of abuse (39) appear: (e. g. the formula) and thy mother' (mata ca)a reviles.

sanskrit_iast: ṛṅ moghamannaṃ nindā ca śāpo yo metyṛgeva tu | yāñcā yadindra citreti kṣepo'bhīdamiti tvaci ||
meaning: ऋङ् मोघमन्नं निन्दा च शापो यो मेत्यृगेव तु | याञ्चा यदिन्द्र चित्रेति क्षेपोऽभीदमिति त्वचि ||
text: The stanza 'vain food' (mogham annam: x. 117. 6) is blame (35), while the stanza 'who me' (yo ma: vii. 104. 16) is a curse (39). 'What, wondrous Indra' (yad indra citra: v. 39. 1) is a request (35), while in the stanza 'over this world' (abhidam: x. 48. 7) there is invective

sanskrit_iast: āśīstu vāta ā vātu daṇḍeti paridevanā | praśnaśca prativākyaṃ ca pṛcchāmi tvetyṛcau pṛthak ||
meaning: आशीस्तु वात आ वातु दण्डेति परिदेवना | प्रश्नश्च प्रतिवाक्यं च पृच्छामि त्वेत्यृचौ पृथक् ||
text: 'May wind waft hither' (vata a vatu: x. 186. 1) is a prayer (35); staves' (dandah: vii. 35. 6) is plaint (35), while the two stanzas 'I ask thee' (prchami tva: i. 164. 34, 35) are respectively question (35) and reply (37).

sanskrit_iast: saṃśayo'dhaḥ svidāsīcca katthanā syādahaṃ manuḥ | imaṃ no yajñamityasyāṃ niyogaḥ pāda ucyate ||
meaning: संशयोऽधः स्विदासीच्च कत्थना स्यादहं मनुः | इमं नो यज्ञमित्यस्यां नियोगः पाद उच्यते ||
text: 'What was below' (adhah svid asit: x. 129. 5) is doubt (35); I was Manu' (aham manuh: iv. 26. 1) would be boasting (35); in the (stanza) 'this our sacrifice' (imam no yajnam: iii. 21. 1) the (first) verse is called commission (36).

sanskrit_iast: iha bravītvanuyogaḥ saṃlāpa ṛgupopa me | pratiṣedhopadeśau tu akṣairmetyakṣasaṃstutau ||
meaning: इह ब्रवीत्वनुयोगः संलाप ऋगुपोप मे | प्रतिषेधोपदेशौ तु अक्षैर्मेत्यक्षसंस्तुतौ ||
text: 'Here let him say' (iha bravitu: i. 164. 7) is injunction (36); the stanza 'clasp me tightly' (upopa me: i. 126. 7) is conversation (36); but not with dice' (aksair ma: x. 34. 13) in the praise of dice a is prohibition and admonition (38).

sanskrit_iast: ākhyānaṃ tu haye jāye vilāpaḥ syānnadasya mā | avīrāmātmanaḥ ślāghā sudeva iti tu spṛhā ||
meaning: आख्यानं तु हये जाये विलापः स्यान्नदस्य मा | अवीरामात्मनः श्लाघा सुदेव इति तु स्पृहा ||
text: 'Ho, wife' (haye jaye: x. 95. 1) is narrative (36); 'of the reed to me' (nadasya ma: i. 179. 4) would be lamentation (36); without a husband' (aviram: x. 86. 9) is a vaunt (36) about oneself, while 'the lover'e (sudevah: x. 95. 14, expresses) desire (35).

sanskrit_iast: namaskāraḥ śunaḥśepe namaste astu vidyute | saṃkalpayannidaṃ tulyo'haṃ syāmiti yaducyate ||
meaning: नमस्कारः शुनःशेपे नमस्ते अस्तु विद्युते | संकल्पयन्निदं तुल्योऽहं स्यामिति यदुच्यते ||
text: Obeisance (37, is expressed) in (the formula of) Sunahsepa, "Obeisance to thee, Lightning' (namas te astu vidyute: Atharva-veda i. 13. 1); but when one resolves what is expressed (with the words) 'I will be equal'

sanskrit_iast: saṃkalpastu yadindrāhaṃ pralāpastvaitaśasya yaḥ | mahānagnyāhanasyā syāt pratirādho bhugityapi ||
meaning: संकल्पस्तु यदिन्द्राहं प्रलापस्त्वैतशस्य यः | महानग्न्याहनस्या स्यात् प्रतिराधो भुगित्यपि ||
text: (there is) resolve (37); 'what, Indra, I' (yad indraham: viii. 14. 1, Atharva-veda xx. 27. 1) is the prattle (37) of Aitasaa; 'the harlot' (mahanagni: Atharva-veda xx. 136. 5) would be a lascivious verse (37); 'bang!' (bhuk: Atharva-veda xx. 135. 1-3), again, (expresses) an obstacle (37).

sanskrit_iast: pramādastveṣa hantāhaṃ na sa sva ityapahnavaḥ | indrākutsetyupapraiṣo na vijānāmi saṃjvaraḥ ||
meaning: प्रमादस्त्वेष हन्ताहं न स स्व इत्यपह्नवः | इन्द्राकुत्सेत्युपप्रैषो न विजानामि संज्वरः ||
text: 'Well, I' (hantaham: x. 119. 9), this (formula) is intoxication (38); 'not our own' (na sa svah: vii. 86. 6) is denial (38); 'O Indra-Kutsa' (indrakutsa: v. 31. 9) is invitation (38); 'I discern not' (na vi janami: i. 164. 37) is agitation (38).

sanskrit_iast: hotā yakṣaditi praiṣaḥ ko adyeti tu vismayaḥ | jāmaye'pahnavo naiṣā vitatādiḥ pravalhikā ||
meaning: होता यक्षदिति प्रैषः को अद्येति तु विस्मयः | जामयेऽपह्नवो नैषा विततादिः प्रवल्हिका ||
text: 'Let the invoker worship' (hota yaksat: i. 139. 10) is a summons (35); 'who, to-day' (ko adya: i. 84. 16 or iv. 25. 1) is wonder (38); 'to his brother not' (na jamaye: iii. 31. 2) a-this (stanza) is denial (38); (there is) an enigma (35) which begins 'outstretched' (vitatau: Atharva-veda xx. 133. 1-6).

sanskrit_iast: na mṛtyurāsīdityetām ācikhyāsāṃ pracakṣate | abhiśāpo'prajāḥ santu bhadramāśīstu gotame ||
meaning: न मृत्युरासीदित्येताम् आचिख्यासां प्रचक्षते | अभिशापोऽप्रजाः सन्तु भद्रमाशीस्तु गोतमे ||
text: 'Death was not' (na mrtyur asit: x. 129. 2)-this (stanza) they pronounce to be narration (36); 'may they be childless' (aprajah santu: i. 25. 5) is a curse (39), while 'blessed' (bhadram: i. 89. 8) is a prayer in Gotama.

sanskrit_iast: bahvapyevaṃprakāraṃ tu śakyaṃ draṣṭumitīdṛśam | vaktuṃ prayogataścaiṣām ṛksūktārdharcasaṃśritam ||
meaning: बह्वप्येवंप्रकारं तु शक्यं द्रष्टुमितीदृशम् | वक्तुं प्रयोगतश्चैषाम् ऋक्सूक्तार्धर्चसंश्रितम् ||
text: Much else of this kind can be found, and can in accordance with the application (prayogatas) of these (formulas) be stated to be such, when contained in stanzas, (whole) hymns, and hemistichs.

sanskrit_iast: ete tu mantravākyārthā devatāṃ sūktabhāginīm | saṃśrayante yathānyāyaṃ stutistvatrānumānikī ||
meaning: एते तु मन्त्रवाक्यार्था देवतां सूक्तभागिनीम् | संश्रयन्ते यथान्यायं स्तुतिस्त्वत्रानुमानिकी ||
text: These contents (vakyarthah) of the formulas are properly connected with the deity belonging to the hymn; but the praise in this case is a matter of inference. •tam

sanskrit_iast: bhavadbhūsya bhavyasya jaṅgamasthāvarasya ca | asyaike sūryamevaikaṃ prabhavaṃ pralayaṃ viduḥ ||
meaning: भवद्भूस्य भव्यस्य जङ्गमस्थावरस्य च | अस्यैके सूर्यमेवैकं प्रभवं प्रलयं विदुः ||
text: Of what is and has been and is to be, and of what moves and is stationary, of all this some regard the Sun alone to be the origin and the cause of dissolution.

sanskrit_iast: asataśca sataścaiva yonireṣā prajāpatiḥ | yadakṣaraṃ ca vācyaṃ ca yathaitadbrahma śāśvatam ||
meaning: असतश्च सतश्चैव योनिरेषा प्रजापतिः | यदक्षरं च वाच्यं च यथैतद्ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् ||
text: Both of what is not and what is, this source is (really) Prajapati, as (being) this eternal Brahma which is at once imperishable (aksaram) and the object of speech (vacyam).

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvaiṣa hi tridhātmānam eṣu lokeṣu tiṣṭhati | devānyathāyathaṃ sarvān niveśya sveṣu raśmiṣu ||
meaning: कृत्वैष हि त्रिधात्मानम् एषु लोकेषु तिष्ठति | देवान्यथायथं सर्वान् निवेश्य स्वेषु रश्मिषु ||
text: He (the Sun), having divided himself into three, abides in these worlds, causing all the gods in due order to rest in his rays.

sanskrit_iast: etadbhūteṣu lokeṣu agnibhūtaṃ sthitaṃ tridhā | ṛṣayo gīrbhirarcanti vyañjitaṃ nāmabhistribhiḥ ||
meaning: एतद्भूतेषु लोकेषु अग्निभूतं स्थितं त्रिधा | ऋषयो गीर्भिरर्चन्ति व्यञ्जितं नामभिस्त्रिभिः ||
text: This (being) which, in the form of fire, abides in three forms (tridha) in the worlds that have come into being, the seers adore with songs as manifested under three names.

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhatyeṣa hi bhūtānāṃ jaṭhare jaṭhare jvalan | tristhānaṃ cainamarcanti hotrāyāṃ vṛktabarhiṣaḥ ||
meaning: तिष्ठत्येष हि भूतानां जठरे जठरे ज्वलन् | त्रिस्थानं चैनमर्चन्ति होत्रायां वृक्तबर्हिषः ||
text: For he abides, glowing, in the interior of every being, and, with sacrificial litter spread, they adore him in the invocation as having three abodes.

sanskrit_iast: ihaiṣa pavamāno'gnir madhyamo'gnirvanaspatiḥ | amuṣminneva viprastu loke'gniḥ śucirucyate ||
meaning: इहैष पवमानोऽग्निर् मध्यमोऽग्निर्वनस्पतिः | अमुष्मिन्नेव विप्रस्तु लोकेऽग्निः शुचिरुच्यते ||
text: Here (on earth) he is by priests called Agni Pavamana, (in the) middle (sphere), Agni Vanaspati, but in that (celestial) world, Agni Suci.

sanskrit_iast: ihāgnibhūtastvṛṣibhir loke stutibhirīḻitaḥ | jātavedā stuto madhye stuto vaiśvānaro divi ||
meaning: इहाग्निभूतस्त्वृषिभिर् लोके स्तुतिभिरीḻइतः | जातवेदा स्तुतो मध्ये स्तुतो वैश्वानरो दिवि ||
text: In this world he is extolled by seers with praises as being Agni, in the middle (world) he is praised as Jatavedas, in heaven he is praised as Vaisvanara.

sanskrit_iast: rasān raśmibhirādāya vāyunāyaṃ gataḥ saha | varṣatyeva ca yalloke tenendra iti sa smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: रसान् रश्मिभिरादाय वायुनायं गतः सह | वर्षत्येव च यल्लोके तेनेन्द्र इति स स्मृतः ||
text: Because, taking up fluids with his rays, accompanied by Vayu, he rains upon the world, he is termed 'Indra.'

sanskrit_iast: agnirasminnathendrastu madhyato vāyureva ca | sūryo divīti vijñeyās tisra eveha devatāḥ ||
meaning: अग्निरस्मिन्नथेन्द्रस्तु मध्यतो वायुरेव च | सूर्यो दिवीति विज्ञेयास् तिस्र एवेह देवताः ||
text: Agni in this (world), Indra and Vayu in the middle, Surya in heaven, are here to be recognized as the three deities.

sanskrit_iast: etāsāmeva māhātmyān nāmānyatvaṃ vidhīyate | tattatsthānavibhāgena tatra tatreha dṛśyate ||
meaning: एतासामेव माहात्म्यान् नामान्यत्वं विधीयते | तत्तत्स्थानविभागेन तत्र तत्रेह दृश्यते ||
text: Owing to the majesty a of these (deities) different names are applied (to each of them); (the diversity of names) here appears in this and that (sphere) according to the division of their respective spheres.

sanskrit_iast: tāsāmiyaṃ vibhūtirhi nāmāni yadanekaśaḥ | āhustāsāṃ tu mantreṣu kavayo'nyonyayonitām ||
meaning: तासामियं विभूतिर्हि नामानि यदनेकशः | आहुस्तासां तु मन्त्रेषु कवयोऽन्योन्ययोनिताम् ||
text: This is a manifestation of their power (vibhuti), that their names are various. The poets, however, in their formulas say that these (deities) have a mutual origin (anyonyayonita).

sanskrit_iast: yathāsthānaṃ pradiṣṭāstā nāmānyatvena devatāḥ | tadbhaktāstatpradhānāśca kecidevaṃ vadanti tāḥ ||
meaning: यथास्थानं प्रदिष्टास्ता नामान्यत्वेन देवताः | तद्भक्तास्तत्प्रधानाश्च केचिदेवं वदन्ति ताः ||
text: These deities are designated by different names according to their sphere. Some speak of them thus as belonging to (bhakta) that (sphere), and chiefly concerned with it.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthakpurastādye tūktā lokādipatayastrayaḥ | teṣāmātmaiva tatsarvaṃ yadyadbhaktiḥ prakīrtyate ||
meaning: पृथक्पुरस्ताद्ये तूक्ता लोकादिपतयस्त्रयः | तेषामात्मैव तत्सर्वं यद्यद्भक्तिः प्रकीर्त्यते ||
text: The Soul (atma) is all a that is proclaimed to be an attribute (bhakti) b of those three chief lords of the world who have been separately mentioned above.

sanskrit_iast: tejastvevāyudhaṃ prāhur vāhanaṃ caiva yasya yat | imāmaindrīṃ ca divyāṃ ca vācamevaṃ pṛthak stutām ||
meaning: तेजस्त्वेवायुधं प्राहुर् वाहनं चैव यस्य यत् | इमामैन्द्रीं च दिव्यां च वाचमेवं पृथक् स्तुताम् ||
text: They say that it is the energy (of the Soul) which is the weapon and the vehicle a of any (god). Similarly (they say) that Speech (Vac) is praised separately as this (terrestrial) one, as connected with Indra (in the middle sphere), and as celestial.

sanskrit_iast: bahudevatā stutayo dvivatsaṃstutayaśca yāḥ | prādhānyameva sarvāsu patīnāmeva tāsvapi ||
meaning: बहुदेवता स्तुतयो द्विवत्संस्तुतयश्च याः | प्राधान्यमेव सर्वासु पतीनामेव तास्वपि ||
text: In all those praises which are addressed to many deities, and in those joint praises which are in the dual, the (three) lords (of the world) are predominant.

sanskrit_iast: sthānaṃ nāmāni bhaktīśca devatāyā stutau stutau | saṃpādayannupekṣeta yāṃ kāṃcidiha saṃpadam ||
meaning: स्थानं नामानि भक्तीश्च देवताया स्तुतौ स्तुतौ | संपादयन्नुपेक्षेत यां कांचिदिह संपदम् ||
text: In bringing out (sampadayan) the sphere, the names, and the attributes (bhaktih) of a deity in each praise, one should here observe every possible means of doing so (sampadam).

sanskrit_iast: agnibhaktistutānsarvān agnāveva samāpayet | yadindrabhakti taccendre sūrye sūryānugaṃ ca yat ||
meaning: अग्निभक्तिस्तुतान्सर्वान् अग्नावेव समापयेत् | यदिन्द्रभक्ति तच्चेन्द्रे सूर्ये सूर्यानुगं च यत् ||
text: All who are praised with the attributes (bhakti) of Agni, one should sum up (samapayet) in Agni, and what has the attributes of Indra, in Indra, and what is attached to Surya, in Surya.

sanskrit_iast: nirupyate haviryasyai sūktaṃ ca bhajate ca yā | saiva tatra pradhānaṃ syān na nipātena yā stutā ||
meaning: निरुप्यते हविर्यस्यै सूक्तं च भजते च या | सैव तत्र प्रधानं स्यान् न निपातेन या स्तुता ||
text: That deity to whom the oblation is offered, and to whom the hymn belongs, will there be the chief object (of praise), not (the deity) who is praised incidentally.

sanskrit_iast: iti trayāṇāmeteṣām uktaḥ sāmāsiko vidhiḥ | samāsenaivamuktastu vistareṇa tvanukramaḥ ||
meaning: इति त्रयाणामेतेषाम् उक्तः सामासिको विधिः | समासेनैवमुक्तस्तु विस्तरेण त्वनुक्रमः ||
text: Thus the rule about these three (gods) has been stated in a general way. But after it has thus been stated in general, the list (of the gods is as follows) in detail.

sanskrit_iast: avaśyaṃ veditavyo hi nāmnāṃ sarvasva vistaraḥ | nahi nāmānyavijñāya mantrāḥ śakyā hi veditum ||
meaning: अवश्यं वेदितव्यो हि नाम्नां सर्वस्व विस्तरः | नहि नामान्यविज्ञाय मन्त्राः शक्या हि वेदितुम् ||
text: For the detailed account of the names of each must necessarily be known, since it is impossible to know the formulas without cognisance of the names.

sanskrit_iast: sattvānyamūrtānyapi ca devatāvanmaharṣayaḥ | tuṣṭuvurṛṣayaḥ śaktyā tāsu tāsu stutiṣviha ||
meaning: सत्त्वान्यमूर्तान्यपि च देवतावन्महर्षयः | तुष्टुवुरृषयः शक्त्या तासु तासु स्तुतिष्विह ||
text: Even unembodied beings, the great sages, the seers, have also lauded as deities here, to the best of their ability, in their various

sanskrit_iast: yaistvagnirindraḥ somaśca vāyuḥ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ | candro'tha viṣṇuḥ parjanyaḥ pūṣā cāpyṛbhavo'śvinau ||
meaning: यैस्त्वग्निरिन्द्रः सोमश्च वायुः सूर्यो बृहस्पतिः | चन्द्रोऽथ विष्णुः पर्जन्यः पूषा चाप्यृभवोऽश्विनौ ||
text: (the seers) by whom Agni, Indra, Soma, Vayu, Surya, Brhaspati, the Moon, Visnu, Parjanya, Pusan, the Rbhus, the

sanskrit_iast: rodasī maruto devāḥ pṛthivyāpaḥ prajāpatiḥ | devau ca mitrāvaruṇau pṛthak saha ca tāvubhau ||
meaning: रोदसी मरुतो देवाः पृथिव्यापः प्रजापतिः | देवौ च मित्रावरुणौ पृथक् सह च तावुभौ ||

sanskrit_iast: viśve ca devāḥ savitā tvaṣṭā vai rūpakṛnmataḥ | aśvo'nnamṛtvijo vajro grāvaṇo rathasaṃyutāḥ ||
meaning: विश्वे च देवाः सविता त्वष्टा वै रूपकृन्मतः | अश्वोऽन्नमृत्विजो वज्रो ग्रावणो रथसंयुताः ||

sanskrit_iast: stutāḥ pṛthak pṛthak svaiḥ svaiḥ sūktairṛgbhiśca nāmabhiḥ | stutau stutau pravakṣyāmi tāni teṣāmanukramāt ||
meaning: स्तुताः पृथक् पृथक् स्वैः स्वैः सूक्तैरृग्भिश्च नामभिः | स्तुतौ स्तुतौ प्रवक्ष्यामि तानि तेषामनुक्रमात् ||

sanskrit_iast: vyavasyenmantramāgneyaṃ liṅgairagneśca lakṣitam | haviṣpaṅktipradhānaiśca nāmāhvānaiśca kevalaiḥ ||
meaning: व्यवस्येन्मन्त्रमाग्नेयं लिङ्गैरग्नेश्च लक्षितम् | हविष्पङ्क्तिप्रधानैश्च नामाह्वानैश्च केवलैः ||
text: One should determine a formula to be addressed to Agni when distinguished by the characteristic marks of Agni, which on the one hand consist chiefly of the five oblations (havispankti), and on the other (are) simple invocations by name.

sanskrit_iast: aindrastu mantro vāyavyair liṅgairaindraiśca lakṣyate | nāmadheyaiśca vajrasya balakṛtyā balena ca ||
meaning: ऐन्द्रस्तु मन्त्रो वायव्यैर् लिङ्गैरैन्द्रैश्च लक्ष्यते | नामधेयैश्च वज्रस्य बलकृत्या बलेन च ||
text: A formula addressed to Indra is distinguished by the characteristic marks of Vayu as well as of Indra, and by denominations of the bolt, by mighty activity, and by might.

sanskrit_iast: sauryastu liṅgaiḥ sūryasya guṇaiḥ sarvaiśca taijasaiḥ | nāmadheyaiśca candrasya sūktaṃ ca bhajate'tra yaiḥ ||
meaning: सौर्यस्तु लिङ्गैः सूर्यस्य गुणैः सर्वैश्च तैजसैः | नामधेयैश्च चन्द्रस्य सूक्तं च भजतेऽत्र यैः ||
text: (A formula) addressed to Surya (is distinguished) by the characteristic marks of Surya, as well as by all qualities relating to brilliance, and by those denominations of the moon by which it (the moon) here belongs to the hymn.

sanskrit_iast: etāsāṃ devatānāṃ tu nāmadheyānukīrtanaiḥ | yasya yasyeha yāvanti na vyavasyantyato'nyathā ||
meaning: एतासां देवतानां तु नामधेयानुकीर्तनैः | यस्य यस्येह यावन्ति न व्यवस्यन्त्यतोऽन्यथा ||
text: All such (hymns) of any (seer) here which (authorities) cannot determine by mention of the denominations of these deities, (must be determined) in some other way than this.

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ prayogastveteṣāṃ jyotiṣāṃ triṣu vartatām | lokeṣu mantravidvidvān prayoge nāvasīdati ||
meaning: अयं प्रयोगस्त्वेतेषां ज्योतिषां त्रिषु वर्तताम् | लोकेषु मन्त्रविद्विद्वान् प्रयोगे नावसीदति ||
text: Let this application of these (three) lights a take place in the three worlds (respectively): a wise man knowing the formulas does not fail in the application.

sanskrit_iast: nīyate'yaṃ nṛbhiryasmān nayatyasmādasau ca tam | tenemau cakratuḥ karma sanāmānau pṛthak pṛthak ||
meaning: नीयतेऽयं नृभिर्यस्मान् नयत्यस्मादसौ च तम् | तेनेमौ चक्रतुः कर्म सनामानौ पृथक् पृथक् ||
text: Because this (terrestrial Agni) is led (niyate) by men, and that (celestial Agni) leads him from this (world), therefore these two (Agnis), while having the same name, have performed their work each separately. 'yam

sanskrit_iast: yadvidyate hi jātaḥ sañ jātairyadvātra vidyate | tenemau tulyanāmānau ubhau lokau samāpnrutaḥ ||
meaning: यद्विद्यते हि जातः सञ् जातैर्यद्वात्र विद्यते | तेनेमौ तुल्यनामानौ उभौ लोकौ समाप्न्रुतः ||
text: Because he is known (vidyate) when born (jatah), or because he is known (vidyate) here by creatures (jataih), therefore these two, while having an identical name (i. e. jatavedas), pervade (samapnutah) b both worldsc (separately). hi jatah san 14, hi

sanskrit_iast: visṛjannayameteṣāṃ bhrājate vyomni madhyamaḥ | nipātamātre kathyante tathāgneyāni kānicit ||
meaning: विसृजन्नयमेतेषां भ्राजते व्योम्नि मध्यमः | निपातमात्रे कथ्यन्ते तथाग्नेयानि कानिचित् ||
text: He (Agni), as the middlemost of these (three), shines in the air discharging (rain): thus some (names) of Agni are mentioned only incidentally.

sanskrit_iast: arcibhiḥ keśyayaṃ tvagnir vidyudbhiścaiva madhyamaḥ | asau tu raśmibhiḥ keśī tenainānāha kaiśinaḥ ||
meaning: अर्चिभिः केश्ययं त्वग्निर् विद्युद्भिश्चैव मध्यमः | असौ तु रश्मिभिः केशी तेनैनानाह कैशिनः ||
text: This (terrestrial) Agni is hairy (kesi) with flames, and the middle one with lightnings, while that (celestial) one is hairy with rays: therefore (the poet) calls them hairy ones (kesinah).

sanskrit_iast: eteṣāṃ tu pṛthaktvena trayāṇāṃ keśināmiha | saṃlakṣyante prakriyāsu trayaḥ keśina ityṛci ||
meaning: एतेषां तु पृथक्त्वेन त्रयाणां केशिनामिह | संलक्ष्यन्ते प्रक्रियासु त्रयः केशिन इत्यृचि ||
text: Now owing to the separate nature of these three hairy ones here, they are distinguished in their specific characters (prakriyasu) in the stanza, 'Three hairy ones' (trayah kesinaha: i. 164.44).

sanskrit_iast: na caivaiṣāṃ prasūtirvā vibhūtisthānajanma vā | nirvaktuṃ śakyametairhi kṛtsnaṃ vyāptamidaṃ jagat ||
meaning: न चैवैषां प्रसूतिर्वा विभूतिस्थानजन्म वा | निर्वक्तुं शक्यमेतैर्हि कृत्स्नं व्याप्तमिदं जगत् ||
text: It is impossible to explain their production (prasuti) or their power, sphere, and birth: for the whole of this world is pervaded by them.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānaraṃ śrito hyagnir agniṃ vaiśvānaraḥ śritaḥ | anayorjātavedāstu tathaite jātavedasī ||
meaning: वैश्वानरं श्रितो ह्यग्निर् अग्निं वैश्वानरः श्रितः | अनयोर्जातवेदास्तु तथैते जातवेदसी ||
text: Agni is contained in (srita) Vaisvanara, Vaisvanara is contained in Agni; Jatavedas is in these two; thus these two (lights) are two (forms of) Jatavedas.

sanskrit_iast: sālokyāccaikajātatvād vyāptimattvāttu tejasaḥ | tasya tasyeha devatvaṃ dṛśyante ca pṛthak stutāḥ ||
meaning: सालोक्याच्चैकजातत्वाद् व्याप्तिमत्त्वात्तु तेजसः | तस्य तस्येह देवत्वं दृश्यन्ते च पृथक् स्तुताः ||
text: The divine nature of each god here (is derived) from their belonging to the same world, from their having one and the same birth, and from brilliance being inherent in them; at the same time (ca) they appear praised separately.

sanskrit_iast: yattvāgneyamiti brūmaḥ sūktabhāk tatra pārthivaḥ | jātavedasyamityukte sūkte'sminmadhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: यत्त्वाग्नेयमिति ब्रूमः सूक्तभाक् तत्र पार्थिवः | जातवेदस्यमित्युक्ते सूक्तेऽस्मिन्मध्यमः स्मृतः ||
text: When we speak of (a hymn) as addressed to Agni, the terrestrial one in that case owns the hymn (suktabhaj). When a hymn is stated to be addressed to Jatavedas, the middle (Agni) has been taught (as the object of praise) in it.

sanskrit_iast: vaiśvānarīyamiti tu yatra brūmo'tha vā kvacit | sūryaḥ sūktasya bhāk tatra jñeyo vaiśvānarastutau ||
meaning: वैश्वानरीयमिति तु यत्र ब्रूमोऽथ वा क्वचित् | सूर्यः सूक्तस्य भाक् तत्र ज्ञेयो वैश्वानरस्तुतौ ||
text: Or when again we speak anywhere of (a hymn) as addressed to Vaisvanara, Surya is in that case to be recognized in the praise of Vaisvanara to be the owner (bhaj) of the hymn.

sanskrit_iast: sūryaprasūtāvagnī tu dṛṣṭau pārthivamadhyamau | eteṣāmeva lokānāṃ trayāṇāmadhvare'dhvare ||
meaning: सूर्यप्रसूतावग्नी तु दृष्टौ पार्थिवमध्यमौ | एतेषामेव लोकानां त्रयाणामध्वरेऽध्वरे ||
text: Now the terrestrial and the middle (Agnis) are seen to be produced (prasuta) from the sun at each sacrifice (the priest), wishing to perform the litany to Agni and the Maruts according to the descending series (which is) the reverse of the ascending series a of these three worlds, begins with a hymn to

sanskrit_iast: rohātpratyavaroheṇa cikīrṣannāgnimārutam | śastraṃ vaiśvānarīyeṇa sūktena pratipadyate ||
meaning: रोहात्प्रत्यवरोहेण चिकीर्षन्नाग्निमारुतम् | शस्त्रं वैश्वानरीयेण सूक्तेन प्रतिपद्यते ||

sanskrit_iast: tatastu madhyamasthānā devatāstvanuśaṃsati | rudraṃ ca marutaścaiva stotriye'gnimimaṃ punaḥ ||
meaning: ततस्तु मध्यमस्थाना देवतास्त्वनुशंसति | रुद्रं च मरुतश्चैव स्तोत्रियेऽग्निमिमं पुनः ||
text: Then he lauds next the deities of the middle sphere, Rudra and the Maruts, (and) again a this (terrestrial) Agni in the Stotriya.

sanskrit_iast: yathaitaduktameteṣāṃ vibhūtisthānasaṃbhavam | tathā ca devadevasya tatra tatreha dṛśyate ||
meaning: यथैतदुक्तमेतेषां विभूतिस्थानसंभवम् | तथा च देवदेवस्य तत्र तत्रेह दृश्यते ||
text: Just as this has been said of these (three) as arising from (their different) powers and spheres, so it also appears here in its respective place (as applicable) to the god of gods (Prajapati).

sanskrit_iast: yadyatra pṛthivīsthānaṃ pārthivaṃ cāgnimāśritam | tatsarvamānupūrvyeṇa kathyamānaṃ nibodhata ||
meaning: यद्यत्र पृथिवीस्थानं पार्थिवं चाग्निमाश्रितम् | तत्सर्वमानुपूर्व्येण कथ्यमानं निबोधत ||
text: Whatever (appears) anywhere as belonging to the sphere of earth, and as contained in the terrestrial Agni, attend to all that (now) being told in due order.

sanskrit_iast: jātavedāḥ śrito hyagnim agniṃ vaiśvānaraḥ śritaḥ | draviṇodāstathedhmaśca śritaścāgniṃ tanūnapāt ||
meaning: जातवेदाः श्रितो ह्यग्निम् अग्निं वैश्वानरः श्रितः | द्रविणोदास्तथेध्मश्च श्रितश्चाग्निं तनूनपात् ||
text: Jatavedas is contained in Agni, Vaisvanara is contained in Agni; so also are Dravinodas, and Fuel (idhma), and Tanunapat is contained in Agni.

sanskrit_iast: narāśaṃsaḥ śritaścainam enamevāśritastvilaḥ | barhirdvāraśca devyo'gnim enameva tu saṃśritāḥ ||
meaning: नराशंसः श्रितश्चैनम् एनमेवाश्रितस्त्विलः | बर्हिर्द्वारश्च देव्योऽग्निम् एनमेव तु संश्रिताः ||
text: Narasamsa is contained in him, in him is contained Ila, the Litter and the Divine Doors are contained in this Agni.

sanskrit_iast: naktoṣāsā ca daivyau ca hotārāvetadāśrayau | devyastisraḥ śritāścainaṃ tvaṣṭā caivaitadāśrayaḥ ||
meaning: नक्तोषासा च दैव्यौ च होतारावेतदाश्रयौ | देव्यस्तिस्रः श्रिताश्चैनं त्वष्टा चैवैतदाश्रयः ||
text: Night and Dawna, and the two Divine Sacrificers are contained in him; and the Three Goddesses are contained in him, and Tvastr is contained in him. daivyau frº, all the rest

sanskrit_iast: śrito vanaspatiścainaṃ svāhākṛtaya eva ca | aśvaśca śakuniścaiva maṇḍūkāścaitadāśrayāḥ ||
meaning: श्रितो वनस्पतिश्चैनं स्वाहाकृतय एव च | अश्वश्च शकुनिश्चैव मण्डूकाश्चैतदाश्रयाः ||
text: Vanaspati is contained in him, also the Svahakrtis; and & the Steed, and the Bird, and the Frogs are contained in him.

sanskrit_iast: grāvāṇaścainamakṣāśca narāśaṃsastathā rathaḥ | dundubhiśceṣudhiñcainaṃ hastaghno'bhīśavo dhanuḥ ||
meaning: ग्रावाणश्चैनमक्षाश्च नराशंसस्तथा रथः | दुन्दुभिश्चेषुधिञ्चैनं हस्तघ्नोऽभीशवो धनुः ||
text: And the Pressing-stones are contained in him, and the Dice, also Narasamsa, the Car, and the Drum, and the Quiver (are contained) in him, the Handguard, the Reins, the Bow

sanskrit_iast: jyā ca tadāśriteṣuśca śritā aśvājanī ca yā | vṛṣabho drughaṇaścainam enaṃ piturulūkhalam ||
meaning: ज्या च तदाश्रितेषुश्च श्रिता अश्वाजनी च या | वृषभो द्रुघणश्चैनम् एनं पितुरुलूखलम् ||
text: And the Bowstring is contained in him, and the Arrow, and contained in him are a the Whip, the Bull, and the Mallet, in him the Draught and the Mortar.

sanskrit_iast: nadyaścaivainamāpaśca sarvā oṣadhayaśca ha | rātryapvāgnāyyaraṇyānī śraddheḻā pṛthivī tathā ||
meaning: नद्यश्चैवैनमापश्च सर्वा ओषधयश्च ह | रात्र्यप्वाग्नाय्यरण्यानी श्रद्धेḻआ पृथिवी तथा ||
text: And the Rivers (are contained) in him, and the Waters and all the Plants; Ratri, Apva, Agnayi, Aranyani, Sraddha, Ila, and Prthivi.

sanskrit_iast: bhajete cainamevārlī dvandvabhūte ca rodasī | musalolūkhale cainaṃ havirdhāne ca ye smṛte ||
meaning: भजेते चैनमेवार्ली द्वन्द्वभूते च रोदसी | मुसलोलूखले चैनं हविर्धाने च ये स्मृते ||
text: And the two Ends of the Bow belong to him and the Two Worlds a forming a pair, and Pestle and Mortar (belong) to him, and the two Oblation-carts as they are called. 12.

sanskrit_iast: joṣṭrī corjāhutī cainaṃ śutudryā ca vipāṭ saha | yau ca devau śunāsīrau tau cāgnī caitadāśrayau ||
meaning: जोष्ट्री चोर्जाहुती चैनं शुतुद्र्या च विपाट् सह | यौ च देवौ शुनासीरौ तौ चाग्नी चैतदाश्रयौ ||
text: The two Fostering (goddesses) a and the two worshipped with strengthening oblations (are contained) in him, and the Vipas together with the Sutudri, and the two Agnis, the divine Suna and Sira, are contained in him. II.

sanskrit_iast: loko'yaṃ yacca vai prātaḥ savanaṃ kriyate makhe | vasantaśaradau cartuṃ stomo'nuṣṭubatho trivṛt ||
meaning: लोकोऽयं यच्च वै प्रातः सवनं क्रियते मखे | वसन्तशरदौ चर्तुं स्तोमोऽनुष्टुबथो त्रिवृत् ||
text: This World a and the morning Soma pressing which is performed at the sacrifice, and the two seasons, Spring and Autumn, the Anustubh (metre) and the Trivrt Stoma;

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrī caikaviṃśaśca yacca sāma rathaṃtaram | sādhyāḥ sāma ca vairājam āptyāśca vasubhiḥ saha ||
meaning: गायत्री चैकविंशश्च यच्च साम रथंतरम् | साध्याः साम च वैराजम् आप्त्याश्च वसुभिः सह ||

sanskrit_iast: indreṇa ca marudbhiśca somena varuṇena ca | parjanyenartubhiścaiva viṣṇunā cāsya saṃstavaḥ ||
meaning: इन्द्रेण च मरुद्भिश्च सोमेन वरुणेन च | पर्जन्येनर्तुभिश्चैव विष्णुना चास्य संस्तवः ||
text: With Indra and the Maruts, with Soma and Varuna, with Parjanya and the Seasons, and with Visnub he shares praise.

sanskrit_iast: asyaivāgnestu pūṣṇā ca sāmrājyaṃ varuṇena ca | devatāmarthatattvajño mantraiḥ saṃyojayeddhaviḥ ||
meaning: अस्यैवाग्नेस्तु पूष्णा च साम्राज्यं वरुणेन च | देवतामर्थतत्त्वज्ञो मन्त्रैः संयोजयेद्धविः ||
text: This same Agni shares sovereignty with Pusan a and with Varuna. One who knows the essential meaning (of the formulas) should connect b the deity (and) the oblation by means of the formulas.

sanskrit_iast: asaṃstutasyāpi sato havirekaṃ nirupyate | devatāvāhanaṃ caiva vahanaṃ haviṣāṃ tathā ||
meaning: असंस्तुतस्यापि सतो हविरेकं निरुप्यते | देवतावाहनं चैव वहनं हविषां तथा ||
text: Even though (a god) be not praised along with (another in the dual), one and the same oblation is (occasionally) offered (to both). The bringing of the gods, as well as the taking of the oblations (to them)

sanskrit_iast: karma dṛṣṭe ca yatkiṃcid viṣaye parivartate | ityukto'yaṃ gaṇaḥ sarvaḥ pṛthivyagnyāśrayo mahān ||
meaning: कर्म दृष्टे च यत्किंचिद् विषये परिवर्तते | इत्युक्तोऽयं गणः सर्वः पृथिव्यग्न्याश्रयो महान् ||

sanskrit_iast: yaścaindro madhyamasthāno gaṇaḥ so'yamataḥ paraḥ | vimānāni ca divyāni gaṇaścāpsarasāṃ tathā ||
meaning: यश्चैन्द्रो मध्यमस्थानो गणः सोऽयमतः परः | विमानानि च दिव्यानि गणश्चाप्सरसां तथा ||
text: Now the group of the middle sphere belonging to Indra follows here, (including) the celestial cars and the group of the Apsarases.

sanskrit_iast: indrāśrayastu parjanyo rudro vāyurbṛhaspatiḥ | varuṇaḥ kaśca mṛtyuśca devaśca brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
meaning: इन्द्राश्रयस्तु पर्जन्यो रुद्रो वायुर्बृहस्पतिः | वरुणः कश्च मृत्युश्च देवश्च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ||
text: In Indra a are contained Parjanya, Rudra, Vayu, Brhaspati, Varuna, Ka, Mrtyu, and the god Brahmanaspati;

sanskrit_iast: manyuśca viśvakarmā ca mitraḥ kṣetrapatiryamaḥ | tārkṣyo vāstoṣpatiścaiva sarasvāṃścaivamatra ha ||
meaning: मन्युश्च विश्वकर्मा च मित्रः क्षेत्रपतिर्यमः | तार्क्ष्यो वास्तोष्पतिश्चैव सरस्वांश्चैवमत्र ह ||
text: Manyu, Visvakarman, Mitra, Ksetrapati, Yama, Tarksya, as well as Vastospati, and also Sarasvat are here;

sanskrit_iast: apāṃnapāddadhikrāśca suparṇo'tha purūravāḥ | ṛto'sunītirvenaśca tasyaitasyāśraye'ditiḥ ||
meaning: अपांनपाद्दधिक्राश्च सुपर्णोऽथ पुरूरवाः | ऋतोऽसुनीतिर्वेनश्च तस्यैतस्याश्रयेऽदितिः ||
text: Apam napat and Dadhikra, then Suparna, Pururavas, Rta, Asuniti, Vena; in his sphere (asraye) also is

sanskrit_iast: tvaṣṭā ca savitā caiva vāto vācaspatistathā | dhātā prajāpatiścaiva atharvāṇaśca ye smṛtāḥ ||
meaning: त्वष्टा च सविता चैव वातो वाचस्पतिस्तथा | धाता प्रजापतिश्चैव अथर्वाणश्च ये स्मृताः ||

sanskrit_iast: śyenaścaivaivamagniśca tatheḻā caiva yā smṛtā | vidhātendurahirbudhnyaḥ somo'hiratha candramāḥ ||
meaning: श्येनश्चैवैवमग्निश्च तथेḻआ चैव या स्मृता | विधातेन्दुरहिर्बुध्न्यः सोमोऽहिरथ चन्द्रमाः ||

sanskrit_iast: viśvānaraśca vai devo rudrāṇāṃ saṃstuto gaṇaḥ | maruto'ṅgirasaścaiva pitaraścarbhubhiḥ saha ||
meaning: विश्वानरश्च वै देवो रुद्राणां संस्तुतो गणः | मरुतोऽङ्गिरसश्चैव पितरश्चर्भुभिः सह ||

sanskrit_iast: rākā vāk saramāptyāśca bhṛgavo'ghnyā sarasvatī | yamyurvaśī sinīvālī pathyā svastiruṣāḥ kuhūḥ ||
meaning: राका वाक् सरमाप्त्याश्च भृगवोऽघ्न्या सरस्वती | यम्युर्वशी सिनीवाली पथ्या स्वस्तिरुषाः कुहूः ||
text: Raka, Vac, Sarama, and the Aptyas, the

sanskrit_iast: pṛthivyanumatirdhenuḥ sītā lākṣā tathaiva gauḥ | gaurī ca rodasī caiva indrāṇyāścaiṣa vai patiḥ ||
meaning: पृथिव्यनुमतिर्धेनुः सीता लाक्षा तथैव गौः | गौरी च रोदसी चैव इन्द्राण्याश्चैष वै पतिः ||
text: Earth, Anumati, Dhenu, Sita, Laksa, likewise Go and Gauri, as well as Rodasi; and he (Indra) is the husband of Indrani. sita

sanskrit_iast: chandastriṣṭrup ca paṅktiśca lokānāṃ madhyamaśca yaḥ | eteṣvevāśrayo vidyāt savanaṃ madhyamaṃ ca yat ||
meaning: छन्दस्त्रिष्ट्रुप् च पङ्क्तिश्च लोकानां मध्यमश्च यः | एतेष्वेवाश्रयो विद्यात् सवनं मध्यमं च यत् ||
text: The metre Tristubha and Pankti and the middlemost of the worlds and the middle (i. e. midday) pressing (of Soma), one should know, (belong to his) sphere among these same

sanskrit_iast: ṛtū ca groṣmahemantau yaśca sāmocyate bṛhat | śakvarīṣu ca yadgītaṃ nāmnā tatsāma śākvaram ||
meaning: ऋतू च ग्रोष्महेमन्तौ यश्च सामोच्यते बृहत् | शक्वरीषु च यद्गीतं नाम्ना तत्साम शाक्वरम् ||

sanskrit_iast: āha caivāsya dvau stomāv āśrayau śākaṭāyanaḥ | yaśca pañcadaśo nāmnā saṃkhyayā triṇavaśca yaḥ ||
meaning: आह चैवास्य द्वौ स्तोमाव् आश्रयौ शाकटायनः | यश्च पञ्चदशो नाम्ना संख्यया त्रिणवश्च यः ||
text: Sakatayana, moreover, says that to him (Indra) belong (asya asrayau) two Stomas, (viz.) that which is called the fifteenfold (pancadasa), and that which is three times nine in number (trinava)a.

sanskrit_iast: saṃstutaścaiva pūṣṇā ca viṣṇunā varuṇena ca | somavāyvagnikutsaiśca brahmaṇaspatinaiva ca ||
meaning: संस्तुतश्चैव पूष्णा च विष्णुना वरुणेन च | सोमवाय्वग्निकुत्सैश्च ब्रह्मणस्पतिनैव च ||
text: He is praised in combination (samstutah) with Pusan and Visnu and Varuna, and with Soma, Vayu, Agni, Kutsa, as well as

sanskrit_iast: bṛhataspatinā caiva nāmnā yaścāpi parvataḥ | kāsucitkecidityāhur nipātā stutiṣu stutāḥ ||
meaning: बृहतस्पतिना चैव नाम्ना यश्चापि पर्वतः | कासुचित्केचिदित्याहुर् निपाता स्तुतिषु स्तुताः ||

sanskrit_iast: mitraśca śrūyate devo varuṇena sahāsakṛt | rudreṇa somaḥ pūṣṇā ca punaḥ pūṣā ca vāyunā ||
meaning: मित्रश्च श्रूयते देवो वरुणेन सहासकृत् | रुद्रेण सोमः पूष्णा च पुनः पूषा च वायुना ||
text: And the god Mitra is frequently praised a in the sacred text (sruyate) with Varuna, Soma with Rudra and Pusan, and again Pusan with Vayu; 32 mitrasca A, mitrastu B.

sanskrit_iast: vātenaiva ca parjanyo lakṣyate'nyatra vai kvacit | ṛkṣvardharceṣu pādeṣu sūkteṣveṣu tu kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
meaning: वातेनैव च पर्जन्यो लक्ष्यतेऽन्यत्र वै क्वचित् | ऋक्ष्वर्धर्चेषु पादेषु सूक्तेष्वेषु तु कृत्स्नशः ||

sanskrit_iast: rasādānaṃ tu karmāsya vṛtrasya ca nibarhaṇam | stuteḥ prabhutvaṃ sarvasya balasya nikhilā kṛtiḥ ||
meaning: रसादानं तु कर्मास्य वृत्रस्य च निबर्हणम् | स्तुतेः प्रभुत्वं सर्वस्य बलस्य निखिला कृतिः ||
text: Now the taking up a of moisture is his function, and the destruction of Vrtra, (and)-the prevailing feature (prabhutvam) of (his) praise-the complete accomplishment of every (kind of) mighty deed.

sanskrit_iast: ityaindro madhyamasthāno gaṇaḥ samyagudāhṛtaḥ | yaḥ parastu gaṇaḥ sauryo dyusthānastaṃ nibodhata ||
meaning: इत्यैन्द्रो मध्यमस्थानो गणः सम्यगुदाहृतः | यः परस्तु गणः सौर्यो द्युस्थानस्तं निबोधत ||
text: Thus Indra's group belonging to the middle sphere has been duly specified. Now learn the following group of the heavenly sphere (and) belonging to Surya.

sanskrit_iast: tasya mukhyatamau devāv aśvinau sūryamāśritau | vṛṣākapāyī sūryoṣāḥ sūryasyaiva tu patnayaḥ ||
meaning: तस्य मुख्यतमौ देवाव् अश्विनौ सूर्यमाश्रितौ | वृषाकपायी सूर्योषाः सूर्यस्यैव तु पत्नयः ||
text: The two chief gods & of that (group) connected with Surya are_the_ASvins; while Vrsakapayi, Surya, and Usas (C) are the wives of Suryad.

sanskrit_iast: amuto'rvāṅ nivartante pratilomāstadāśrayāḥ | purodayāttāmuṣasaṃ sūryāṃ madhyaṃdine sthite ||
meaning: अमुतोऽर्वाङ् निवर्तन्ते प्रतिलोमास्तदाश्रयाः | पुरोदयात्तामुषसं सूर्यां मध्यंदिने स्थिते ||
text: From that (heavenly world) they return hitherward, reversed, in connexion with him ( Surya). They call her Usas before sunrise, Surya when midday

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣākapāyīṃ sūryasya tāmevāhustu nimruci | tasyāśraye saraṇyūśca bhagaḥ pūṣā vṛṣākapiḥ ||
meaning: वृषाकपायीं सूर्यस्य तामेवाहुस्तु निम्रुचि | तस्याश्रये सरण्यूश्च भगः पूषा वृषाकपिः ||

sanskrit_iast: yamo vaiśvānaro viṣṇur varuṇaścaikapādajaḥ | pṛthivī ca samudraśca devāḥ saptarṣayaśca ye ||
meaning: यमो वैश्वानरो विष्णुर् वरुणश्चैकपादजः | पृथिवी च समुद्रश्च देवाः सप्तर्षयश्च ये ||
text: Yama, Vaisvanara, Visnu, Varuna, Aja ekapad, and Earth (prthivi), and Ocean (samudra), the Gods, and the Seven Seers (saptarsayah); vaisvanarah all MSS., visvanarah Naighantuka v. 6 as well as 5 (both celestial and atmospheric); the latter form occurs above, i. 127.

sanskrit_iast: ādityāḥ keśisādhyāśca savitā vasubhirmanuḥ | dadhyaṅṅatharvā viśve ca vājino devapatnayaḥ ||
meaning: आदित्याः केशिसाध्याश्च सविता वसुभिर्मनुः | दध्यङ्ङथर्वा विश्वे च वाजिनो देवपत्नयः ||

sanskrit_iast: asau tṛtīyaṃ savanaṃ lokaḥ sāma ca raivatam | vairūpaṃ caiva varṣāśca śiśiro'tha ṛtustathā ||
meaning: असौ तृतीयं सवनं लोकः साम च रैवतम् | वैरूपं चैव वर्षाश्च शिशिरोऽथ ऋतुस्तथा ||
text: That (heavenly) world, the third (Soma) pressing, the Raivata and the Vairupa chant (saman), and the Rains as well as the Cold Season;

sanskrit_iast: trayastriṃśaśca ya stomaḥ klṛptyā saptadaśaśca yaḥ | chandaśca jagatī nāmnā tathātichandasaśca yāḥ ||
meaning: त्रयस्त्रिंशश्च य स्तोमः क्लृप्त्या सप्तदशश्च यः | छन्दश्च जगती नाम्ना तथातिछन्दसश्च याः ||

sanskrit_iast: pauruṣaṃ cāhurasyaitat sarvameva te pauruṣam | etasyaiva tu vijñeyā devāḥ saṃstavikāstrayaḥ ||
meaning: पौरुषं चाहुरस्यैतत् सर्वमेव ते पौरुषम् | एतस्यैव तु विज्ञेया देवाः संस्तविकास्त्रयः ||
text: And what relates to Purusa, they say, is his (asya); now all this (universe: etat sarvam) is related to Purusa. Three gods are to be recognized as associated with him (etasya) in praise:

sanskrit_iast: candramāścaiva vāyuśca yaṃ ca saṃvatsaraṃ viduḥ | kecittu nirvapantyasya sauryavaiśvānaraṃ haviḥ ||
meaning: चन्द्रमाश्चैव वायुश्च यं च संवत्सरं विदुः | केचित्तु निर्वपन्त्यस्य सौर्यवैश्वानरं हविः ||
text: (viz.) the Moon and Wind (Vayu) and that which is regarded as the Year (samvatsara). Now some offer to him an oblation addressed to Surya and Vaisvanara.

sanskrit_iast: sauryavaiśvānarīyaṃ hi tatsūktamiva dṛśyate | ṛgardharco'thavā pādo dvṛco vā yadi vā tṛcaḥ ||
meaning: सौर्यवैश्वानरीयं हि तत्सूक्तमिव दृश्यते | ऋगर्धर्चोऽथवा पादो द्वृचो वा यदि वा तृचः ||
text: For (the hymn) addressed to Surya and Vaisvanara a appears like a hymn of his (Surya's: tat-suktam): (whether) a stanza, a hemistich, or a verse, or a couplet, or a triplet (is regarded).

sanskrit_iast: anena tu pravādena dṛṣṭā mūrdhanvatā stutiḥ | sūryavaiśvānarāgnīnām aikātmyamiha dṛśyate ||
meaning: अनेन तु प्रवादेन दृष्टा मूर्धन्वता स्तुतिः | सूर्यवैश्वानराग्नीनाम् ऐकात्म्यमिह दृश्यते ||
text: But by that expression containing the word 'head'a (his) praise is apparent. Here the identity of Surya, Vaisvanara, and Agni appears.

sanskrit_iast: haraṇaṃ tu rasasyaitat karmāmutra ca raśmibhiḥ | yena nātivijānanti sarvabhūtāni cakṣuṣā ||
meaning: हरणं तु रसस्यैतत् कर्मामुत्र च रश्मिभिः | येन नातिविजानन्ति सर्वभूतानि चक्षुषा ||
text: Now the holding (harana) of moisture in that (celestial) world (amutra) also by means of (his) rays-this is (his) function: 36 wherefore all beings fail to distinguish (him) very clearly by the eye.

sanskrit_iast: vibhāgamimameteṣāṃ vibhūtisthānasaṃbhavam | saṃyagvijānanmantreṣu taṃ tu karmasu yojayet ||
meaning: विभागमिममेतेषां विभूतिस्थानसंभवम् | संयग्विजानन्मन्त्रेषु तं तु कर्मसु योजयेत् ||
text: Now distinguishing correctly in the formulas this distribution of these (three deities) which arises a from (their different) powers and spheres, vijanan '14, vijanam, vijnana hmtk, vijnanam f, vijnaya 1. a Vibhuti-sthana-sambhavam, a bahuvrihi, as in i. 104; but vibhuti-sthana-janma in i. 96 is a dvandva.

sanskrit_iast: 'adhyāpayannadhīyāno mantraṃ caivānukīrtayan | sthānaṃ sālokyaṃ sāyujyam eteṣāmeva gacchati ||
meaning: ऽअध्यापयन्नधीयानो मन्त्रं चैवानुकीर्तयन् | स्थानं सालोक्यं सायुज्यम् एतेषामेव गच्छति ||
text: Teaching, studying, and reciting a formula (addressed to them), a man attains to the sphere of, to identity of world (and) intimate union with, these same (gods).

sanskrit_iast: agnestu yāni sūktāni pañca nāmāni kāravaḥ | ṣaḍviṃśatistathendrasya prāhuḥ sūryasya sapta ca ||
meaning: अग्नेस्तु यानि सूक्तानि पञ्च नामानि कारवः | षड्विंशतिस्तथेन्द्रस्य प्राहुः सूर्यस्य सप्त च ||
text: Now as to the hymns, the poets proclaim (in them) five names of Agni, twenty-six of Indra, and seven of Surya.

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ pṛthaṅnirvacanam ekaikasyeha karmajam | ucyamānaṃ yathānyāyaṃ śṛṇudhvamakhilaṃ mayā ||
meaning: तेषां पृथङ्निर्वचनम् एकैकस्येह कर्मजम् | उच्यमानं यथान्यायं शृणुध्वमखिलं मया ||
text: The separate explanation, based on the functiona (of the god), of each of these here, do ye listen to as duly stated by me in its entirety. a With prthan-nirvacanam karmajam cp. vibhagam vibhuti-sthana-sambhavam in 20.

sanskrit_iast: jāto yadagre bhūtānām agraṇīradhvare ca yat | nāmnā saṃnayate vāṅgaṃ stuto'gniriti sūribhiḥ ||
meaning: जातो यदग्रे भूतानाम् अग्रणीरध्वरे च यत् | नाम्ना संनयते वाङ्गं स्तुतोऽग्निरिति सूरिभिः ||
text: Because he was born at the beginning (ag-re) of beings, and because he is a leader (agra-ni)a at the sacrifice, or (because) he unites (his) body (angam sam-ni), he is praised by sages under the name of

sanskrit_iast: draviṇaṃ dhanaṃ balaṃ vāpi prāyacchadyena karmaṇā | tatkarma dṛṣṭvā kutsastu prāhainaṃ draviṇodasam ||
meaning: द्रविणं धनं बलं वापि प्रायच्छद्येन कर्मणा | तत्कर्म दृष्ट्वा कुत्सस्तु प्राहैनं द्रविणोदसम् ||
text: Kutsa a observing the action by which he bestowed b dravina

sanskrit_iast: ayaṃ tanūnapādagnir asau hi tananāttanuḥ | tatastu madhyamo jajñe sthāne'yaṃ madhyamāttataḥ ||
meaning: अयं तनूनपादग्निर् असौ हि तननात्तनुः | ततस्तु मध्यमो जज्ञे स्थानेऽयं मध्यमात्ततः ||
text: This (terrestrial) Agni is Tanunapat (2). For that (celestial) Agni is tanu from tanana (extending): from him the middle (Agni) was born, then from the middle one, in (his proper) place, this (terrestrial) one.

sanskrit_iast: anantarāṃ prajāmāhur napāditi kṛpaṇyavaḥ | napādamuṣya caivāyam agnistena tanūnapāt ||
meaning: अनन्तरां प्रजामाहुर् नपादिति कृपण्यवः | नपादमुष्य चैवायम् अग्निस्तेन तनूनपात् ||
text: The poets call an immediate a descendant (prajam) grandson (napat), and this (terrestrial) Agni is the grandson b of that (celestial) one; hence he is Tanunapat.

sanskrit_iast: pṛthaktvena samāsaistu yajñe yacchasyate nṛbhiḥ | stuvantyāprīṣu tenemaṃ narāśaṃsaṃ tu kāravaḥ ||
meaning: पृथक्त्वेन समासैस्तु यज्ञे यच्छस्यते नृभिः | स्तुवन्त्याप्रीषु तेनेमं नराशंसं तु कारवः ||
text: Because he is individually (prthaktvena) lauded (sams) by men (nr) a combined at the sacrifice, therefore poets praise this (Agni) as Narasamsa (3) in Apri hymns.

sanskrit_iast: punāti yadidaṃ viśvam evāgniḥ pārthivo'tha ca | vaikhānasarṣibhistena pavamāna iti stutaḥ ||
meaning: पुनाति यदिदं विश्वम् एवाग्निः पार्थिवोऽथ च | वैखानसर्षिभिस्तेन पवमान इति स्तुतः ||
text: And again because the terrestrial Agni purifies (punati) this universe, therefore he is praised by hermit seers as (the Purifier) Pavamana (4).

sanskrit_iast: bhūtāni veda yajjāto jātavedātha kathyate | yaccaiṣa jātavidyo'bhūd vittaṃ jāto'dhivetti vā ||
meaning: भूतानि वेद यज्जातो जातवेदाथ कथ्यते | यच्चैष जातविद्योऽभूद् वित्तं जातोऽधिवेत्ति वा ||
text: There are thus five which correspond more or less to the five given in Nirukta vii. 19: three of these, jatavidya, jatavitta, jate jate vidyate, are followed by the second, third, and fourth in the above two slokas (30, 31), another, jatani veda, is partially followed by the first, while the fifth, jatani.. enam viduh, is followed by the second in i. 92 (jatair vidyate). [Note: The twenty-six names of Indra are (1) Vayu, (2) Varuna, (3) Rudra, (4) Indra, (5) Parjanya, (6) Brhaspati, (7) Brahmanaspati, (8) Ksetrasya pati, (9) Rta, (10) Vastospati, (11) Vacaspati, (12) Aditi, (13) Ka, (14) Yama, (15) Mitra, (16) Visvakarman, (17) Sarasvat, (18) Vena, (19) Manyu, (20) Asuniti, (21) Apam napat, (22) Dadhikra, (23) Dhatr, (24) Tarksya, (25) Pururavas, (26) Mrtyu] 7. The twenty-six names of Indra: Vayu, Varuna, Rudra, Indra.

sanskrit_iast: vidyate sarvabhūtairhi yadvā jātaḥ punaḥ punaḥ | tenaiṣa madhyabhāgendro jātavedā iti stutaḥ ||
meaning: विद्यते सर्वभूतैर्हि यद्वा जातः पुनः पुनः | तेनैष मध्यभागेन्द्रो जातवेदा इति स्तुतः ||

sanskrit_iast: aṇiṣṭha eṣa yattu trīn vyāpyaiko vyomni tiṣṭhati | tenainamṛṣayo'rcantaḥ karmaṇā vāyumabruvan ||
meaning: अणिष्ठ एष यत्तु त्रीन् व्याप्यैको व्योम्नि तिष्ठति | तेनैनमृषयोऽर्चन्तः कर्मणा वायुमब्रुवन् ||
text: But because he, in a most subtle form, abides in the air as the one pervading (vyapya) the three (worlds), the seers adoring (him) by reason of this function, called him Vayua (1).

sanskrit_iast: trīṇīmānyāvṛṇotyeko mūrtena tu rasena yat | tayainaṃ varuṇaṃ śaktyā stutiṣvāhuḥ kṛpaṇyavaḥ ||
meaning: त्रीणीमान्यावृणोत्येको मूर्तेन तु रसेन यत् | तयैनं वरुणं शक्त्या स्तुतिष्वाहुः कृपण्यवः ||
text: But because with concrete moisture he alone covers (vrnoti) a these three (worlds), the singers in their praises speak of him, by reason of this faculty, as Varuna (2).

sanskrit_iast: arododantarikṣe yad vidyudvṛṣṭiṃ dadannṛṇām | caturbhirṛṣibhistena rudra ityabhisaṃstutaḥ ||
meaning: अरोदोदन्तरिक्षे यद् विद्युद्वृष्टिं ददन्नृणाम् | चतुर्भिरृषिभिस्तेन रुद्र इत्यभिसंस्तुतः ||
text: Because he roared (arodit) a in the air, giving rain with lightning b to men, therefore he is highly praised by four seers c as Rudra (3).

sanskrit_iast: caturvidhānāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇo bhūtvā vyavasthitaḥ | īṣṭe caivāsya sarvasya tenendra iti sa smṛtaḥ ||
meaning: चतुर्विधानां भूतानां प्राणो भूत्वा व्यवस्थितः | ईष्टे चैवास्य सर्वस्य तेनेन्द्र इति स स्मृतः ||
text: And having become the established (source of) life of the four kinds of beings, he rules (iste) over this universe; therefore he has been named Indra (4).

sanskrit_iast: irāṃ dṛṇāti yatkāle marudbhiḥ sahito'mbare | raveṇa mahatā yuktas tenendramṛṣayo'bruvan ||
meaning: इरां दृणाति यत्काले मरुद्भिः सहितोऽम्बरे | रवेण महता युक्तस् तेनेन्द्रमृषयोऽब्रुवन् ||
text: Because he, associated with the Maruts, at the (proper) time bursts open (drnati) refreshment (iram) a in the sky, accompanied with great roar, therefore the seers called him Indra. - 1.

sanskrit_iast: yadimāṃ prārjayatyeko rasenāmbarajena gām | kāle'triraurvaśaścarṣī tena parjanyamāhatuḥ ||
meaning: यदिमां प्रार्जयत्येको रसेनाम्बरजेन गाम् | कालेऽत्रिरौर्वशश्चर्षी तेन पर्जन्यमाहतुः ||
text: Because he alone endows (prarjayati) a this earth at the (proper) time with moisture produced from the sky, therefore the seers Atrib and the son of Urvasi (Vasistha) speak of him as Parjanya (5).

sanskrit_iast: tarpayatyeṣa yallokāñ janyo janahitaśca yat | paro jetā janayitā yadvāgneyastato jagau ||
meaning: तर्पयत्येष यल्लोकाञ् जन्यो जनहितश्च यत् | परो जेता जनयिता यद्वाग्नेयस्ततो जगौ ||

sanskrit_iast: bṛhantau pāti yallokāv eṣa dvau madhyamottamau | bṛhatā karmaṇā tena bṛhaspatiritīḻitaḥ ||
meaning: बृहन्तौ पाति यल्लोकाव् एष द्वौ मध्यमोत्तमौ | बृहता कर्मणा तेन बृहस्पतिरितीḻइतः ||

sanskrit_iast: brahma vāg brahma satyaṃ ca brahma sarvamidaṃ jagat | pātāraṃ brahmaṇastena śaunahotra stuvañjagau ||
meaning: ब्रह्म वाग् ब्रह्म सत्यं च ब्रह्म सर्वमिदं जगत् | पातारं ब्रह्मणस्तेन शौनहोत्र स्तुवञ्जगौ ||

sanskrit_iast: annaṃ kṣitibhyo vidadhad yadṛtuṣvaviśatkṣitau | tenainamāha kṣetrasya vāmadeva stuvanpatim ||
meaning: अन्नं क्षितिभ्यो विदधद् यदृतुष्वविशत्क्षितौ | तेनैनमाह क्षेत्रस्य वामदेव स्तुवन्पतिम् ||

sanskrit_iast: manasemaṃ tu yaddṛśyaṃ madhyamaṃ lokamāśritam | śaṃsatsatyena satye vai sa eṣa stutavānṛtam ||
meaning: मनसेमं तु यद्दृश्यं मध्यमं लोकमाश्रितम् | शंसत्सत्येन सत्ये वै स एष स्तुतवानृतम् ||

sanskrit_iast: raveṇāntārasaiḥ kṣiptai sthito vyomnyeṣa māyayā | ṛtasya śloka ityeṣa punaścainaṃ tato'bravīt ||
meaning: रवेणान्तारसैः क्षिप्तै स्थितो व्योम्न्येष मायया | ऋतस्य श्लोक इत्येष पुनश्चैनं ततोऽब्रवीत् ||
text: And by his magical power he abides in the air with internal moisture a shed with thunder: hence he (Vamadeva) again b spoke of him (as such in) 'the call of Rta' (rtasya slokah)c.

sanskrit_iast: vāstuprayacchaṃllokasya madhyamaḥ sa tu pāti yat | tena vāstoṣpatiṃ prāha caturbhirimamaurvaśaḥ ||
meaning: वास्तुप्रयच्छंल्लोकस्य मध्यमः स तु पाति यत् | तेन वास्तोष्पतिं प्राह चतुर्भिरिममौर्वशः ||
text: But because (being in the) middle (sphere) he granting an abode (vastu) to the world, protects (it), therefore the son of Urvasi (Vasistha) proclaims him (to be) Vastospati (10) in four (formulas).

sanskrit_iast: vācā vedā hyadhīyante vācā chandāṃsi tatra ha | atho vāk sarvamevedaṃ tena vācaspati stutaḥ ||
meaning: वाचा वेदा ह्यधीयन्ते वाचा छन्दांसि तत्र ह | अथो वाक् सर्वमेवेदं तेन वाचस्पति स्तुतः ||
text: Since the Vedas are learned with speech (vac), (and) the metres there (are recited) with speech, and moreover speech is this universe, therefore (he is) praised as 'Lord of Speech' (11). k.-This sloka (45) is

sanskrit_iast: na kutaścana yaddīno vṛtvā tiṣṭhati madhyamaḥ | rāhūgaṇa ṛṣistena prāhainaṃ gotamo'ditim ||
meaning: न कुतश्चन यद्दीनो वृत्वा तिष्ठति मध्यमः | राहूगण ऋषिस्तेन प्राहैनं गोतमोऽदितिम् ||
text: And because he abides (in the) middle (sphere) surrounding (the world), not afflicted (dina) on any side, therefore the seer Rahugana Gotamab proclaims him as Aditi (12).

sanskrit_iast: prajābhyastveṣa yaccharma kamicchanmanasā sukham | hiraṇyagarbhastenainam ṛṣirarcannuvāca kam ||
meaning: प्रजाभ्यस्त्वेष यच्छर्म कमिच्छन्मनसा सुखम् | हिरण्यगर्भस्तेनैनम् ऋषिरर्चन्नुवाच कम् ||
text: But because he is a protection to creatures, desiring (their) ka-happiness (sukha) a-in his heart, therefore the seer Hiranyagarbha, adoring (him), spoke of him as Ka (13).

sanskrit_iast: iha prajāḥ prayacchansa saṃgṛhītvā prayāti ca | ṛṣirvivasvataḥ putraṃ tenāhainaṃ yamo yamam ||
meaning: इह प्रजाः प्रयच्छन्स संगृहीत्वा प्रयाति च | ऋषिर्विवस्वतः पुत्रं तेनाहैनं यमो यमम् ||
text: He giving (prayachan) offspring here, and gathering (them) goes forth (to the other world): therefore the seer Yamac calls him, the son of Vivasvat, Yama e (14).

sanskrit_iast: mitrīkṛtya janā viśve yadimaṃ paryupāsate | mitra ityāha tenainaṃ viśvāmitra stuvansvayam ||
meaning: मित्रीकृत्य जना विश्वे यदिमं पर्युपासते | मित्र इत्याह तेनैनं विश्वामित्र स्तुवन्स्वयम् ||
text: Because all men making (mitrikrtya) a friend (of him) worship him, therefore Visvamitra a himself praising (him) calls him 'Mitra'b (15).

sanskrit_iast: nidāghamāsātigame yadṛtenāvati kṣitim | viśvasya janayankarma viśvakarmaiṣa tena saḥ ||
meaning: निदाघमासातिगमे यदृतेनावति क्षितिम् | विश्वस्य जनयन्कर्म विश्वकर्मैष तेन सः ||
text: Because at the close of the hot months he refreshes the earth with water (rta), creating the activity (karma) of everything (visvasya), therefore he (is called) Visvakarman (16). nidaghamasatigame faziqatanfana m'r, faziatanfafaqa hd, fazraatanfana £k, faztuat- sanigame.

sanskrit_iast: sarāṃsi ghṛtavantyasya santi lokeṣu yattriṣu | sarasvantamiti prāha vācaṃ prāhuḥ sarasvatīm ||
meaning: सरांसि घृतवन्त्यस्य सन्ति लोकेषु यत्त्रिषु | सरस्वन्तमिति प्राह वाचं प्राहुः सरस्वतीम् ||
text: Because he has lakes (saramsi) full of ghee in the three worlds, (the seer) a proclaims (him) as 'Sarasvat', (while) Vac (speech) they call Sarasvati.

sanskrit_iast: prāṇabhūtastu bhūteṣu yadvenatyeṣu tiṣṭhati | tenainaṃ venamāharṣir veno nāmeha bhārgavaḥ ||
meaning: प्राणभूतस्तु भूतेषु यद्वेनत्येषु तिष्ठति | तेनैनं वेनमाहर्षिर् वेनो नामेह भार्गवः ||
text: Because being their life (prana) he moves (venati)abides in them, therefore the seer named Vena Bhargava b here calls him Vena (18).

sanskrit_iast: sasṛje māsi māsyenam abhimatya tapo'grajam | tenainaṃ manyurityāha manyureva tu tāpasaḥ ||
meaning: ससृजे मासि मास्येनम् अभिमत्य तपोऽग्रजम् | तेनैनं मन्युरित्याह मन्युरेव तु तापसः ||
text: Primaeval (agraja) Heat (tapas), desiring (abhimatya), created him month after month: therefore Manyu Tapasa calls him

sanskrit_iast: yadantakāla bhūtānām eka eva nayatyasūn | tenāsunītirukto'yaṃ stuvatā śrutabandhunā ||
meaning: यदन्तकाल भूतानाम् एक एव नयत्यसून् | तेनासुनीतिरुक्तोऽयं स्तुवता श्रुतबन्धुना ||
text: Because at the time when beings die he alone leads (nayati) (their) spirits (asun), therefore he is spoken of as Asuniti (20) by Srutabandhub who praises (him).

sanskrit_iast: nidāghamāsātigame janma madhye bhavatyapām | naptāramāha tenainam ṛṣirgṛtsamada stuvan ||
meaning: निदाघमासातिगमे जन्म मध्ये भवत्यपाम् | नप्तारमाह तेनैनम् ऋषिर्गृत्समद स्तुवन् ||
text: At the end of the hot months (his) birth takes place in (their) midst a therefore the seer Grtsamada (in) praising (him) calls him Child of Waters (21).

sanskrit_iast: apāmambaragarbhaugham ādadhatso'ṣṭamāsikam | yatkrandatyasakṛnmadhye dadhikrāstena kathyate ||
meaning: अपामम्बरगर्भौघम् आदधत्सोऽष्टमासिकम् | यत्क्रन्दत्यसकृन्मध्ये दधिक्रास्तेन कथ्यते ||
text: Because supporting (a-dadhat) the mass of waters contained in the atmosphere a for eight months, he roars (krandati) frequently in (their) midst, therefore he is described as Dadhikra (22).

sanskrit_iast: māsena saṃbhṛtaṃ garbhaṃ navamenātha māsikam | svayaṃ krandandadhātyurvyāṃ dhātetyṛgbhiḥ sa gīyate ||
meaning: मासेन संभृतं गर्भं नवमेनाथ मासिकम् | स्वयं क्रन्दन्दधात्युर्व्यां धातेत्यृग्भिः स गीयते ||
text: He then himself roaring deposits (dadhati) in the earth for a month, the germ developed in the ninth month: (therefore) he is sung in stanzas (of the Rg-veda) as 'Dhatr'a (23).

sanskrit_iast: stīrṇe'ntarikṣe kṣiyati yadvā tūrṇaṃ kṣaratyasau | ariṣṭanemistārkṣyarṣis tārkṣyaṃ tenaivamuktavān ||
meaning: स्तीर्णेऽन्तरिक्षे क्षियति यद्वा तूर्णं क्षरत्यसौ | अरिष्टनेमिस्तार्क्ष्यर्षिस् तार्क्ष्यं तेनैवमुक्तवान् ||
text: In the wide (stirne) air he dwells (ksiyati) or he swiftly (turnam) glides (ksarati): therefore the seer Aristanemi Tarksya c has spoken of him thus as Tarksya (24).

sanskrit_iast: ruvanvyomnyudayaṃ yāti kṛntatrādvisṛjannapaḥ | purūravasamāhainaṃ svavākyenoruvāsinī ||
meaning: रुवन्व्योम्न्युदयं याति कृन्तत्राद्विसृजन्नपः | पुरूरवसमाहैनं स्ववाक्येनोरुवासिनी ||
text: Roaring (ruvan) in the sky he proceeds to sunrise, discharging a the waters from the abyss (krntatrat)b: (therefore) Uruvasinic (i. e. Urvasi) calls him Pururavas (25) d in her own words e.

sanskrit_iast: yattu pracyāvayanneti ghoṣeṇa mahatā mṛtam | tena mṛtyumimaṃ santaṃ stauti mṛtyuriti svayam ||
meaning: यत्तु प्रच्यावयन्नेति घोषेण महता मृतम् | तेन मृत्युमिमं सन्तं स्तौति मृत्युरिति स्वयम् ||
text: But because with great din he goes driving on the deceased (mrtam), therefore him, as being death (mrtyu), the youngest son of Yama, named Samkusuka, himself praises as 'Mrtyu' (26). Causing the darkness to disappear from the sun and Dawn to appear, r, - - 60.

sanskrit_iast: nāmnā saṃkusuko nāma yamaputro jaghanyajaḥ | saṃvartayaṃstamaḥ sūryād uṣasaṃ ca pravartayan ||
meaning: नाम्ना संकुसुको नाम यमपुत्रो जघन्यजः | संवर्तयंस्तमः सूर्याद् उषसं च प्रवर्तयन् ||

sanskrit_iast: udito bhāsayaṃllokān imāṃścaiṣa svaraśmibhiḥ | svayaṃ vasiṣṭhastenainam ṛṣirāha stuvanbhagam ||
meaning: उदितो भासयंल्लोकान् इमांश्चैष स्वरश्मिभिः | स्वयं वसिष्ठस्तेनैनम् ऋषिराह स्तुवन्भगम् ||

sanskrit_iast: puṣyan kṣitiṃ poṣayati praṇudan raśmibhistamaḥ | tenainamastautpūṣeti bharadvājastu pañcabhiḥ ||
meaning: पुष्यन् क्षितिं पोषयति प्रणुदन् रश्मिभिस्तमः | तेनैनमस्तौत्पूषेति भरद्वाजस्तु पञ्चभिः ||
text: Nourishing (pusyan) he causes the earth to thrive, dispelling the darkness with his rays: therefore Bharadvaja praised, him as 'Pusan' (3) with five (hymns).

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi bhānti rajāṃsyasya yatpadāni tu tejasā | tena medhātithiḥ prāha viṣṇumenaṃ trivikramam ||
meaning: त्रीणि भान्ति रजांस्यस्य यत्पदानि तु तेजसा | तेन मेधातिथिः प्राह विष्णुमेनं त्रिविक्रमम् ||
text: Because the three (trini) regions (rajamsi) shine with brilliance as his footsteps, therefore Medhatithi a pronounces him (to be) Visnu (4) of the three strides (trivikrama).

sanskrit_iast: kṛtvā sāyaṃ pṛthagyāti bhūtebhyastamaso'tyaye | prakāśaṃ kiraṇaiḥ kurvaṃs tenainaṃ keśinaṃ viduḥ ||
meaning: कृत्वा सायं पृथग्याति भूतेभ्यस्तमसोऽत्यये | प्रकाशं किरणैः कुर्वंस् तेनैनं केशिनं विदुः ||
text: Because, after making a sojourn (sayam) apart, he goes, at the departure of darkness, making light (prakasam) for beings with his beams, therefore they regard him as (the Hairy) Kesin (5).

sanskrit_iast: saṃpratyekaikaśastvenaṃ yanmanyante pṛthaṅnarāḥ | viśve viśvānarastena karmaṇā stutiṣu stutaḥ ||
meaning: संप्रत्येकैकशस्त्वेनं यन्मन्यन्ते पृथङ्नराः | विश्वे विश्वानरस्तेन कर्मणा स्तुतिषु स्तुतः ||
text: Because all men (visve narah) now singly (and) separately think a of him, by reason of this function he is praised in laudations as Visvanara (6).

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣaiṣa kapilo bhūtvā yannākamadhirohati | vṛṣākapirasau tena viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ | raśmibhiḥ kampayanneti vṛṣā varṣiṣṭha eva saḥ ||
meaning: वृषैष कपिलो भूत्वा यन्नाकमधिरोहति | वृषाकपिरसौ तेन विश्वस्मादिन्द्र उत्तरः | रश्मिभिः कम्पयन्नेति वृषा वर्षिष्ठ एव सः ||
text: Because having become a brown (kapila) bulla (vrsa), he mounts the firmament, therefore he is Vrsakapi (7), (in) 'Indra is above all' (Rg-veda x. 86); (or) this highest bull (vrsa) goes causing to waver (kampayan) with (his)

sanskrit_iast: sāyāhnakāle bhūtāni svāpayannastameti yat | vṛṣākapirito vā syād iti mantreṣu dṛśyate ||
meaning: सायाह्नकाले भूतानि स्वापयन्नस्तमेति यत् | वृषाकपिरितो वा स्याद् इति मन्त्रेषु दृश्यते ||
text: (i. e.) because he goes home (astam) at eventide causing beings to sleep, (his name) Vrsakapi may be (derived) from this; for in the three formulas beginning 'the waste' (dhanva: Rg-veda x. 86. 20-22) in the hymn to Vrsakapi, he appears to be bidden c thus (iti) by Indra.

sanskrit_iast: triṣu dhanveti hīndreṇa prayukto vāriṣākape | viṣṇāterviśatervā syād veveṣṭervyāptikarmaṇaḥ | viṣṇurnirucyate sūryaḥ sarvaṃ sarvāntaraśca yaḥ ||
meaning: त्रिषु धन्वेति हीन्द्रेण प्रयुक्तो वारिषाकपे | विष्णातेर्विशतेर्वा स्याद् वेवेष्टेर्व्याप्तिकर्मणः | विष्णुर्निरुच्यते सूर्यः सर्वं सर्वान्तरश्च यः ||
text: Visnua may be from (the root) vis (visnati) or vis (visati), (or) from vevis (vevesti), expressing pervasion: (he) is (thus) explained as the Sun who is everything and is contained in everything.

sanskrit_iast: pañca ṣaḍviṃśatiścaiva yāni nāmāni sapta ca | samyagagnīndrasūryāṇāṃ tānyuktāni yathākramam ||
meaning: पञ्च षड्विंशतिश्चैव यानि नामानि सप्त च | सम्यगग्नीन्द्रसूर्याणां तान्युक्तानि यथाक्रमम् ||
text: The five, the twenty-six, and the seven names of Agni, Indra, and Surya (respectively), have (thus) been duly stated in succession.

sanskrit_iast: naipātikānāṃ nāmnāṃ tu prāguktairnāmalakṣaṇaiḥ | saṃpannānāṃ pṛthaktvena parisaṃkhyā na vidyate ||
meaning: नैपातिकानां नाम्नां तु प्रागुक्तैर्नामलक्षणैः | संपन्नानां पृथक्त्वेन परिसंख्या न विद्यते ||
text: But of the incidental names, accompanied by the abovementioned b nominal characteristics (nama-laksanaih), a separate enumeration does not exist.

sanskrit_iast: pārthivī madhyamā divyā vāgapi trividhā tu yā | tasyāḥ sūktāni nāmāni yathāsthānaṃ nibodhata ||
meaning: पार्थिवी मध्यमा दिव्या वागपि त्रिविधा तु या | तस्याः सूक्तानि नामानि यथास्थानं निबोधत ||
text: As to Speech (Vac) also, who is threefold as terrestrial, middle, (and) celestial, listen to (an account of) her hymns (and) names according to her sphere.

sanskrit_iast: kṛtsnaṃ tu bhajate sūktam eṣā nadya stutā bhuvi | yadā cainaṃ bhajantyāpo yadā cauṣadhayo yadā ||
meaning: कृत्स्नं तु भजते सूक्तम् एषा नद्य स्तुता भुवि | यदा चैनं भजन्त्यापो यदा चौषधयो यदा ||
text: Now she owns the entire hymn when the rivers on earth, and when the waters, (and) when the plants, being praised, own it.

sanskrit_iast: agnāyī nāmato'pyeṣā bhūtvāgneyeṣu keṣucit | stutā nipātamātreṇa tatra tatreha dṛśyate ||
meaning: अग्नायी नामतोऽप्येषा भूत्वाग्नेयेषु केषुचित् | स्तुता निपातमात्रेण तत्र तत्रेह दृश्यते ||
text: Also when she becomes Agnayi a by name, she appears here (in the Rg-veda) in various passages (tatra tatra) praised only incidentally in some (hymns) addressed to Agni.

sanskrit_iast: madhye satyaditirvāk ca bhūtvā caiṣā sarasvatī | samagraṃ bhajate sūktaṃ tribhireva tu nāmabhiḥ ||
meaning: मध्ये सत्यदितिर्वाक् च भूत्वा चैषा सरस्वती | समग्रं भजते सूक्तं त्रिभिरेव तु नामभिः ||
text: When she, being Vaca in the middle (sphere), has become Aditi and Sarasvati, she owns the complete hymn under (these) three names only.

sanskrit_iast: eṣaiva durgā bhūtvarcaṃ kṛtvā syātsūktabhāginī | tannāmāni yamīndrāṇī saramā romaśorvaśī | bhavatyagrayā sinīvālī rākā cānumatiḥ kuhūḥ ||
meaning: एषैव दुर्गा भूत्वर्चं कृत्वा स्यात्सूक्तभागिनी | तन्नामानि यमीन्द्राणी सरमा रोमशोर्वशी | भवत्यग्रया सिनीवाली राका चानुमतिः कुहूः ||
text: [She on becoming Durga (and) uttering a stanza may own (whole) hymn] b. Her (other)

sanskrit_iast: gaurdhenurdevapatnyo'ghnyā pathyā svastiśca rodasī | naipātikāni ṛgbhāñji yeṣāṃ nāmāni kānicit ||
meaning: गौर्धेनुर्देवपत्न्योऽघ्न्या पथ्या स्वस्तिश्च रोदसी | नैपातिकानि ऋग्भाञ्जि येषां नामानि कानिचित् ||

sanskrit_iast: yadā tu vāgbhavatyeṣā sūryāmuṃ lokamāśritā | tathā sūktamuṣā bhūtvā sūryā ca bhajate'khilam ||
meaning: यदा तु वाग्भवत्येषा सूर्यामुं लोकमाश्रिता | तथा सूक्तमुषा भूत्वा सूर्या च भजतेऽखिलम् ||
text: But when this Vac becomes Surya, she belongs to that (celestial) world: thus on becoming Usas as well as Surya, she owns the entire hymn.

sanskrit_iast: vṛṣākapāyyṛcaṃ bhūtvā saraṇyūrdve ca te dhruvam | nipātamātraṃ bhajate dyuvacca pṛthivī satī ||
meaning: वृषाकपाय्यृचं भूत्वा सरण्यूर्द्वे च ते ध्रुवम् | निपातमात्रं भजते द्युवच्च पृथिवी सती ||
text: And when she becomes Vrsakapayi (and) Saranyu, these two undoubtedly (own) a stanza. And when she is Earth corresponding to Heaven (dyuvat), she only owns (a stanza) incidentally d dve ca te

sanskrit_iast: sūryāmeva satīmetāṃ gaurīṃ vācaṃ sarasvatīm | paśyāmo vaiśvadeveṣu nipātenaiva kevalāḥ ||
meaning: सूर्यामेव सतीमेतां गौरीं वाचं सरस्वतीम् | पश्यामो वैश्वदेवेषु निपातेनैव केवलाः ||
text: We see that when this Vac is Surya, Gauria, Sarasvati, they (are) in the hymns to the All-gods (praised) incidentally only.

sanskrit_iast: ghoṣā godhā viśvavārā apālopaniṣanniṣat | brahmajāyā jahūrnāma agastyasya svasāditiḥ ||
meaning: घोषा गोधा विश्ववारा अपालोपनिषन्निषत् | ब्रह्मजाया जहूर्नाम अगस्त्यस्य स्वसादितिः ||
text: Ghosa, Godha, Visvavara, Apala, Upanisad, Nisade, Brahmajaya (who is) named Juhuf, the sister of

sanskrit_iast: indrāṇī cendramātā ca saramā romaśorvaśī | lopāmudrā ca nadyaśca yamī nārī ca śaśvatī ||
meaning: इन्द्राणी चेन्द्रमाता च सरमा रोमशोर्वशी | लोपामुद्रा च नद्यश्च यमी नारी च शश्वती ||

sanskrit_iast: śrīrlākṣā sārparājñī vāk śraddhā medhā ca dakṣiṇā | rātrī sūryā ca sāvitrī brahmavādinya īritāḥ ||
meaning: श्रीर्लाक्षा सार्पराज्ञी वाक् श्रद्धा मेधा च दक्षिणा | रात्री सूर्या च सावित्री ब्रह्मवादिन्य ईरिताः ||
text: Sri, Laksa, Sarparajnic, Vacd, Sraddha e, Medhaf, Sraddhae, Daksina, Ratri h, and Surya Savitrii, (all these) are pronounced to be female seers (brahmavadinyah).

sanskrit_iast: navakaḥ prathamastvāsāṃ vargastuṣṭāva devatāḥ | ṛṣibhirdevatābhiśca samūde madhyamo gaṇaḥ ||
meaning: नवकः प्रथमस्त्वासां वर्गस्तुष्टाव देवताः | ऋषिभिर्देवताभिश्च समूदे मध्यमो गणः ||
text: The first group of these, consisting of nine, praised the deities; the middle series b conversed with seers and deities.

sanskrit_iast: ātmano bhāvavṛttāni jagau vargastathottamaḥ | uttamasya tu vargasya ya ṛṣiḥ saiva devatā ||
meaning: आत्मनो भाववृत्तानि जगौ वर्गस्तथोत्तमः | उत्तमस्य तु वर्गस्य य ऋषिः सैव देवता ||
text: So the last group sang of the evolutionary forms (bhava-, vrttani) a of Self. Whoever is the seer (of a hymn by one) of the last group is also the deity.

sanskrit_iast: ātmānamastaudvargastu devatāṃ yastathottamaḥ | tasmādātmastaveṣu syād ya ṛṣiḥ saiva devatā ||
meaning: आत्मानमस्तौद्वर्गस्तु देवतां यस्तथोत्तमः | तस्मादात्मस्तवेषु स्याद् य ऋषिः सैव देवता ||
text: Now (each seer of) the last group thus praised herself as the deity: therefore whoever may be the seer in self-laudations is at the same time the deity.

sanskrit_iast: saṃvādeṣvāha vākyaṃ yaḥ sa tu tasminbhavedṛṣiḥ | yastenocyeta vākyena devatā tatra sā bhavet ||
meaning: संवादेष्वाह वाक्यं यः स तु तस्मिन्भवेदृषिः | यस्तेनोच्येत वाक्येन देवता तत्र सा भवेत् ||
text: He who utters the speech in colloquies should be (regarded as) the seer a in it; whoever may be addressed by that speech should be (regarded as) the deity therein.

sanskrit_iast: uccāvaceṣu cārtheṣu nipātāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ | karmopasaṃgrahārthe ca kvaciccaupamyakāraṇāt ||
meaning: उच्चावचेषु चार्थेषु निपाताः समुदाहृताः | कर्मोपसंग्रहार्थे च क्वचिच्चौपम्यकारणात् ||

sanskrit_iast: ūnānāṃ pūraṇārthā vā pādānāmapare kvacit | mitākṣareṣu grantheṣu pūraṇārthāstvanarthakāḥ ||
meaning: ऊनानां पूरणार्था वा पादानामपरे क्वचित् | मिताक्षरेषु ग्रन्थेषु पूरणार्थास्त्वनर्थकाः ||
text: Others again (are) occasionally (used) for the purpose of filling up a defective verses (pada). Those (particles) which in metrical books have the purpose of filling up (the verse) are meaningless
